// ===== core =====
// Hue Board 5.1.0
// Bundled offline Scriptable application. Source modules and tests are in the source ZIP.
// Local certificate checking is disabled ONLY for private IPv4 Hue endpoints.
// Bridge readback is resource state, not a measurement of emitted light.
const VERSION = '5.1.0';
const STORAGE = 'hue-board.config.v1';
const AUTH_PREFIX = 'hue-board.key.';
const V3_STORE = 'hue-board.workspace.v3';
const V3_SESSION = 'hue-board.sessions.v3';
const V3_SCENES = 'hue-board.scenes.v3';
const FIXTURE_LIMITS_STORE = 'hue-board.fixtureLimits.v5';
const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const finite = v => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
const clone = v => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
const sleep = ms => new Promise(resolve => Timer.schedule(Math.max(1,ms),false,resolve));
const safeJSON = v => JSON.stringify(v).replace(/</g,'\\u003c').replace(/\u2028/g,'\\u2028').replace(/\u2029/g,'\\u2029');
function readObject(key, fallback={}) {
  try { if(!Keychain.contains(key)) return clone(fallback); const v=JSON.parse(Keychain.get(key));
    return v && typeof v==='object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : clone(fallback);
  } catch (_) {return clone(fallback);}
}
function writeObject(key,v) {Keychain.set(key,JSON.stringify(v));}
function validIp(ip) {
  if(typeof ip!=='string'||!/^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}$/.test(ip))return false;
  const p=ip.split('.').map(Number); if(!p.every(n=>n>=0&&n<=255))return false;
  return p[0]===10||(p[0]===172&&p[1]>=16&&p[1]<=31)||(p[0]===192&&p[1]===168);
}
function uid() {return typeof UUID!=='undefined'?UUID.string():Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);}
class HueError extends Error {
  constructor(kind,message,status=0,details=[]) {super(message);this.name='HueError';this.kind=kind;this.status=status;this.details=details;}
}
function errorKind(e) {return e && e.kind || 'unknown';}
function shortError(e) {return String(e&&e.message||e).replace(/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}/g,'[redacted]').slice(0,300);}
function resourceAck(reply,rid) {return !!(reply&&Array.isArray(reply.data)&&reply.data.some(r=>r&&r.rid===rid));}
function assertAck(reply,rid) {if(!resourceAck(reply,rid))throw new HueError('protocol','Bridge response did not acknowledge the expected resource. Check readback before retrying.');}
async function choose(title,message,labels,cancel='Back') {
  const a=new Alert();a.title=title;a.message=message;for(const label of labels)a.addAction(label);a.addCancelAction(cancel);return await a.presentSheet();
}
async function inform(title,message) {const a=new Alert();a.title=title;a.message=message;a.addAction('OK');await a.presentAlert();}
async function input(title,message,value='') {
  const a=new Alert();a.title=title;a.message=message;a.addTextField('Value',String(value));a.addAction('Save');a.addCancelAction('Cancel');return await a.presentAlert()<0?null:a.textFieldValue(0).trim();
}
async function confirm(title,message) {return await choose(title,message,['Continue'],'Cancel')===0;}

// Do not reuse these identifiers for new data or delete old Keychain entries.
const LEGACY_MIX_APP = 'BOYZ.EXE';
const LEGACY_KEYS = Object.freeze({
  config: 'boyzexe.hue.config.v1',
  authIpPrefix: 'boyzexe.hue.key.',
  authBridgePrefix: 'boyzexe.hue.bridgekey.',
  workspace: 'boyzexe.hue.cyberdeck.v3',
  sessions: 'boyzexe.hue.cyberdeck.sessions.v3',
  scenes: 'boyzexe.hue.cyberdeck.scenes.v3',
  fixtureLimits: 'boyzexe.hue.fixtureLimits.v5',
  olderWorkspace: 'boyzexe.hue.cyberdeck.v2',
  olderRestore: 'boyzexe.hue.cyberdeck.restore.v2'
});
function copyLegacyKey(target, source) {
  if (!Keychain.contains(target) && Keychain.contains(source)) {
    Keychain.set(target, Keychain.get(source));
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function migrateLegacyState() {
  // Migrate once per namespace; never overwrite a newer Hue Board value.
  for (const [newKey, oldKey] of [
    [STORAGE, LEGACY_KEYS.config],
    [V3_STORE, LEGACY_KEYS.workspace],
    [V3_SESSION, LEGACY_KEYS.sessions],
    [V3_SCENES, LEGACY_KEYS.scenes],
    [FIXTURE_LIMITS_STORE, LEGACY_KEYS.fixtureLimits]
  ]) copyLegacyKey(newKey, oldKey);
}
function migrateLegacyBridgeKey(config) {
  if (!validIp(config.ip)) return;
  const canonical = authName(config);
  if (Keychain.contains(canonical)) return;
  const sources = [
    config.bridgeId && LEGACY_KEYS.authBridgePrefix + config.bridgeId,
    AUTH_PREFIX + config.ip,
    LEGACY_KEYS.authIpPrefix + config.ip
  ].filter(Boolean);
  for (const oldKey of sources) {
    if (copyLegacyKey(canonical, oldKey)) return;
  }
}


// ===== engine =====
/** Pure deterministic engine. No I/O, platform APIs, clocks or mutable global state. */
function makeEngine() {
  const TAU=2*Math.PI, cap=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v)), mix=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
  const wrap=x=>((x%1)+1)%1, smooth=x=>{x=cap(x,0,1);return x*x*(3-2*x);};
  const palettes=[
    {name:'Ion storm',colors:['#102cba','#00b9f2','#36e5d1','#a4ed51']},
    {name:'Toxic core',colors:['#10399b','#02bbb8','#80e63c','#fa9228']},
    {name:'Afterburn',colors:['#123da7','#1484e5','#09c9e0','#ff922d']},
    {name:'Void rift',colors:['#1f2b90','#584dc9','#188cc9','#3bdfbd']},
    {name:'Black ice',colors:['#132b66','#1d53a3','#0b9cbc','#4cdad2']},
    {name:'Laser grid',colors:['#2031bf','#04bdd6','#44dc8a','#a8e44d']},
    {name:'Arcade mint',colors:['#142962','#008fa8','#30e5b7','#b8f266']},
    {name:'Solar forge',colors:['#222d6b','#b33b20','#ff7d25','#ffd173']},
    {name:'Pacific',colors:['#10244b','#005f87','#00b5ba','#7ce7d1']},
    {name:'Cobalt chrome',colors:['#172464','#225cf2','#4daff1','#d3ecff']},
    {name:'Acid circuit',colors:['#162a35','#148c68','#78d629','#e5f285']},
    {name:'Lava lamp',colors:['#281d60','#773cbe','#e65932','#ffc85c']},
    {name:'Aurora borealis',colors:['#162953','#197d84','#47d59d','#9b83e6']},
    {name:'Desert dusk',colors:['#343d65','#7b6c96','#c58b66','#e8bc72']},
    {name:'Glacier',colors:['#183b67','#267c9b','#80c9d0','#d8ecf2']},
    {name:'Industrial amber',colors:['#263c45','#566c65','#d69a34','#efd58a']},
    {name:'Ultraviolet',colors:['#212565','#4b40bd','#9254db','#36c6da']},
    {name:'Jungle signal',colors:['#173e3c','#147b54','#55c887','#d8dd4b']},
    {name:'Custom four-color',colors:['#102cba','#00b9f2','#36e5d1','#a4ed51']}
  ];
  const shows=[['director','Director'],['eclipse','Ion Eclipse'],['turbine','Plasma Turbine'],['comet','Afterburner'],['deep','Deep Orbit'],['orbit','Orbit'],['helix','Double helix'],['reactor','Reactor'],['aurora','Aurora'],['prism','Prism'],
    ['wave','Wavefront'],['scanner','Scanner'],['binary','Twin comets'],['ripples','Ripple field'],
    ['pendulum','Pendulum'],['vortex','Vortex'],['breath','Breathing room'],['moire','Moire'],
    ['lattice','Lattice'],['tide','Tidal flow'],['embers','Embers'],['nebula','Nebula'],
    ['ribbons','Ribbons'],['static','Static atmosphere']];
  const defaults={showA:'eclipse',showB:'turbine',paletteA:0,paletteB:1,morph:0,brightness:60,speed:1,depth:75,spread:1.2,energy:65,tension:65,focus:55,reverse:false,gradient:false,seed:731,topology:'ring',transitionMs:4500,ownership:'yield_off',nativeKind:'palette',effect:'',effectSpeed:0.4,effectTint:false,
    saturation:100,ambientFloor:0,accentMix:100,density:1,phaseOffset:0,brightnessCurve:1,
    directorSeconds:52,customColors:['#102cba','#00b9f2','#36e5d1','#a4ed51'],
    sequenceIds:['ion-eclipse','plasma-turbine','deep-orbit'],sequenceHold:90,sequenceOrder:'forward'};
  function clean(raw) {
    const s=raw&&typeof raw==='object'?raw:{};
    const n=(k,a,b)=>typeof s[k]==='number'&&Number.isFinite(s[k])?cap(s[k],a,b):defaults[k];
    const sh=(k,d)=>shows.some(v=>v[0]===s[k])?s[k]:d;
    return {showA:sh('showA',shows.some(v=>v[0]===s.mode)?s.mode:defaults.showA),showB:sh('showB',defaults.showB),
      paletteA:Math.round(typeof s.palette==='number'&&s.paletteA==null?cap(s.palette,0,palettes.length-1):n('paletteA',0,palettes.length-1)),paletteB:Math.round(n('paletteB',0,palettes.length-1)),
      morph:n('morph',0,100),brightness:n('brightness',5,100),speed:n('speed',0.25,1.6),depth:n('depth',0,100),spread:n('spread',0.5,2),energy:n('energy',0,100),tension:n('tension',0,100),focus:n('focus',0,100),
      reverse:s.reverse===true,gradient:s.gradient===true,seed:Math.round(n('seed',0,999999)),topology:s.topology==='path'?'path':'ring',
      transitionMs:n('transitionMs',2500,15000),ownership:['yield_off','hold'].includes(s.ownership)?s.ownership:'yield_off',
      nativeKind:s.nativeKind==='effect'?'effect':'palette',effect:typeof s.effect==='string'?s.effect.slice(0,40):'',effectSpeed:n('effectSpeed',0,1),effectTint:s.effectTint===true,
      saturation:n('saturation',0,100),ambientFloor:n('ambientFloor',0,65),accentMix:n('accentMix',0,100),density:Math.round(n('density',1,4)),phaseOffset:n('phaseOffset',-1,1),brightnessCurve:n('brightnessCurve',.5,2),directorSeconds:n('directorSeconds',30,180),
      customColors:Array.isArray(s.customColors)&&s.customColors.length===4&&s.customColors.every(v=>typeof v==='string'&&/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v))?s.customColors.map(v=>v.toUpperCase()):defaults.customColors.slice(),
      sequenceIds:Array.isArray(s.sequenceIds)?s.sequenceIds.filter(v=>typeof v==='string'&&/^[a-z0-9-]{1,50}$/.test(v)).slice(0,12):defaults.sequenceIds.slice(),
      sequenceHold:n('sequenceHold',30,600),sequenceOrder:s.sequenceOrder==='shuffle'?'shuffle':'forward'};
  }
  function hash(seed,n){let x=(seed^Math.imul(n+1,0x9e3779b9))>>>0;x=Math.imul(x^(x>>>16),0x21f0aaad);x=Math.imul(x^(x>>>15),0x735a2d97);return ((x^(x>>>15))>>>0)/4294967296;}
  const lin=v=>v<=0.04045?v/12.92:((v+0.055)/1.055)**2.4;
  const gamma=v=>v<=0.0031308?12.92*v:1.055*Math.pow(v,1/2.4)-0.055;
  const rgb=hex=>[1,3,5].map(i=>parseInt(hex.slice(i,i+2),16)/255);
  function lab(c){const [r,g,b]=c.map(lin);const l=Math.cbrt(.4122214708*r+.5363325363*g+.0514459929*b),m=Math.cbrt(.2119034982*r+.6806995451*g+.1073969566*b),s=Math.cbrt(.0883024619*r+.2817188376*g+.6299787005*b);return [.2104542553*l+.793617785*m-.0040720468*s,1.9779984951*l-2.428592205*m+.4505937099*s,.0259040371*l+.7827717662*m-.808675766*s];}
  function unlab(c){const [L,a,b]=c,l=(L+.3963377774*a+.2158037573*b)**3,m=(L-.1055613458*a-.0638541728*b)**3,s=(L-.0894841775*a-1.291485548*b)**3;return [4.0767416621*l-3.3077115913*m+.2309699292*s,-1.2684380046*l+2.6097574011*m-.3413193965*s,-.0041960863*l-.7034186147*m+1.707614701*s].map(v=>cap(gamma(Math.max(0,v)),0,1));}
  function blend(a,b,f){f=cap(f,0,1);if(f===0)return {rgb:a.rgb.slice(),b:a.b};if(f===1)return {rgb:b.rgb.slice(),b:b.b};const al=lab(a.rgb),bl=lab(b.rgb);return {rgb:unlab(al.map((v,i)=>mix(v,bl[i],f))),b:mix(a.b,b.b,f)};}
  function colorMix(a,b,f){return blend({rgb:a,b:0},{rgb:b,b:0},f).rgb;}
  const colors=palettes.map(p=>p.colors.map(rgb));
  const getColors=(s,i)=>i===palettes.length-1?s.customColors.map(rgb):colors[i];
  function trail(q,head,dir,topology,width) {
    const behind=dir*(head-q),d=topology==='ring'?wrap(behind):behind;
    return d>=0 ? (1-Math.exp(-d/.035))*Math.exp(-d/width)*(topology==='ring'?1-smooth((d-.65)/.35):1) : 0;
  }
  function wave(kind,t,q,s,palette) {
    const ring=s.topology==='ring';q=ring?wrap(q*s.density+s.phaseOffset):cap(q+s.phaseOffset,0,1);
    const dir=s.reverse?-1:1,phase=hash(s.seed,1)*TAU;
    const travel=dir*t/38+hash(s.seed,2),head=ring?wrap(travel):.5-.5*Math.cos(TAU*travel);
    const tailBlend=ring?(dir>0?1:0):.5+.5*Math.tanh(8*dir*Math.sin(TAU*travel));
    const dist=x=>ring?Math.min(wrap(x),1-wrap(x)):Math.abs(x);
    const width=mix(.27,.09,s.focus/100)/s.spread;
    const crest=Math.exp(-Math.pow(dist(q-head)/width,2));
    const sine=x=>.5+.5*Math.sin(TAU*x);
    const base=getColors(s,palette),e=s.energy/100;
    let motif=crest,accent=0,shift=.1;
    if(kind==='turbine'||kind==='helix'){const a=sine(2*q-dir*t/38),b=sine(3*q+dir*t/51);motif=a*.6+b*.4;shift=.35*b;accent=Math.pow(a*b,2)*.28;}
    else if(kind==='reactor'){motif=sine(2*q-dir*t/18)*.7+sine(q+dir*t/37)*.3;shift=.2;accent=Math.pow(motif,4)*.18;}
    else if(kind==='comet'){const wake=mix(trail(q,head,-1,s.topology,width*1.7),trail(q,head,1,s.topology,width*1.7),tailBlend);motif=cap(crest*.8+wake*.6,0,1);shift=.07;accent=crest;}
    else if(kind==='deep'){const tide=sine(q+t/99)*.35;motif=.2+tide;const cycle=Math.floor(t/130),at=t%130,start=60+hash(s.seed,cycle+100)*25;accent=Math.sin(Math.PI*cap((at-start)/24,0,1))**2*Math.exp(-Math.pow(dist(q-hash(s.seed,cycle+900))/.22,2));shift=.08;}
    else if(kind==='aurora'){motif=.5+.23*Math.sin(TAU*q+Math.sin(t/23)+phase)+.22*Math.sin(TAU*3*q-t/31);shift=.2*sine(q+t/113);}
    else if(kind==='prism'){motif=sine(2*q-dir*t/55);shift=.4*sine(q-dir*t/87);}
    else if(kind==='wave'){motif=sine(q-dir*t/42);shift=.12;accent=Math.pow(motif,5)*.55;}
    else if(kind==='scanner'){const h=.5-.5*Math.cos(t/13);motif=Math.exp(-Math.pow(dist(q-h)/(width*1.25),2));shift=.08;accent=motif*.45;}
    else if(kind==='binary'){const other=ring?wrap(-head+.5):1-head;const second=Math.exp(-Math.pow(dist(q-other)/width,2));motif=Math.max(crest,second*.8);accent=second*.8;shift=.14;}
    else if(kind==='ripples'){motif=Math.pow(sine(3*q-dir*t/39),2)*(.75+.25*sine(q+t/63));shift=.24;accent=Math.pow(motif,3)*.45;}
    else if(kind==='pendulum'){motif=.5+.5*Math.cos(TAU*q+1.8*Math.sin(t/17));shift=.18*sine(t/57);accent=Math.pow(motif,5)*.25;}
    else if(kind==='vortex'){motif=.5+.3*Math.sin(TAU*2*q-dir*t/15)+.2*Math.sin(TAU*q+dir*t/27);shift=.2;accent=Math.pow(cap(motif,0,1),4)*.6;}
    else if(kind==='breath'){motif=sine(t/32);shift=.1+.15*sine(q);accent=.1*sine(t/79);}
    else if(kind==='moire'){const a=sine(3*q-dir*t/47),b=sine(4*q+dir*t/53);motif=(a+b)*.5;shift=.22*b;accent=Math.pow(a*b,2)*.6;}
    else if(kind==='lattice'){motif=sine(4*q)*(.45+.55*sine(t/35))*.75+.25*sine(q-t/69);shift=.25;accent=Math.pow(motif,3)*.55;}
    else if(kind==='tide'){motif=.5+.5*Math.sin(TAU*q+.7*Math.sin(t/43)-dir*t/23);shift=.2*sine(t/89);accent=Math.pow(motif,5)*.3;}
    else if(kind==='embers'){motif=.3+.35*sine(2*q+t/56+hash(s.seed,8))+.15*sine(3*q-t/79);shift=.2;accent=Math.pow(sine(q+t/32+hash(s.seed,7)),4)*.7;}
    else if(kind==='nebula'){motif=.5+.22*Math.sin(TAU*q+Math.sin(t/27))+.2*Math.cos(TAU*2*q+Math.sin(t/41));shift=.25*sine(t/81);accent=Math.pow(sine(3*q+t/57),4)*.25;}
    else if(kind==='ribbons'){motif=sine(2*q-dir*t/44+Math.sin(t/71)*.25);shift=.35*sine(q+t/113);accent=.4*Math.pow(motif,3);}
    else if(kind==='static'){motif=.5+.25*Math.sin(TAU*q);shift=.12;accent=0;}
    else { // Eclipse / Orbit: atmosphere, broad motion, sparse gentle accents.
      const cycle=Math.floor(t/70),at=t%70,start=42+hash(s.seed,cycle+30)*8;
      accent=Math.sin(Math.PI*cap((at-start)/14,0,1))**2*crest*.32;shift=.05;
    }
    const depth=s.depth/100,contrast=mix(.82,.36+.64*cap(motif,0,1),depth);
    let c=colorMix(base[0],base[1],cap(shift+motif*.78,0,1));
    c=colorMix(c,base[2],.12*motif);
    c=colorMix(c,base[3],cap(accent*(.25+.75*s.tension/100)*s.accentMix/100,0,1));
    return {rgb:c,b:s.brightness*(.62+.38*e)*contrast};
  }
  function show(kind,t,q,s,palette){if(kind!=='director')return wave(kind,t,q,s,palette);const acts=['eclipse','turbine','aurora','comet','prism','deep','ripples','nebula'],hold=s.directorSeconds,n=Math.floor(t/hold),at=t%hold;return blend(wave(acts[n%acts.length],t,q,s,palette),wave(acts[(n+1)%acts.length],t,q,s,palette),smooth((at-(hold-10))/10));}
  function sample(t,q,s,surge=0){const a=show(s.showA,t,q,s,s.paletteA),b=show(s.showB,t,q,s,s.paletteB),v=blend(a,b,s.morph/100);v.b=cap(Math.max(s.ambientFloor/100,Math.pow(cap(v.b/s.brightness,0,1),s.brightnessCurve))*s.brightness*(1+.2*cap(surge,0,1)),1,s.brightness);if(s.saturation<100){const L=lab(v.rgb);v.rgb=unlab([L[0],L[1]*s.saturation/100,L[2]*s.saturation/100]);}return v;}
  function clip(p,gamut){if(!gamut?.red||!gamut?.green||!gamut?.blue)return p;const pts=[gamut.red,gamut.green,gamut.blue];const cross=(a,b,c)=>(b.x-a.x)*(c.y-a.y)-(b.y-a.y)*(c.x-a.x);if(Math.abs(cross(...pts))<1e-9)return p;const sg=pts.map((v,i)=>cross(v,pts[(i+1)%3],p));if(sg.every(v=>v>=-1e-10)||sg.every(v=>v<=1e-10))return p;const near=pts.map((a,i)=>{const b=pts[(i+1)%3],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy,u=d?cap(((p.x-a.x)*dx+(p.y-a.y)*dy)/d,0,1):0;return {x:a.x+u*dx,y:a.y+u*dy};});return near.sort((a,b)=>(a.x-p.x)**2+(a.y-p.y)**2-(b.x-p.x)**2-(b.y-p.y)**2)[0];}
  function xy(c,gamut){const [r,g,b]=c.map(lin),X=r*.4124564+g*.3575761+b*.1804375,Y=r*.2126729+g*.7151522+b*.072175,Z=r*.0193339+g*.119192+b*.9503041,tot=X+Y+Z;const p=clip(tot>1e-12?{x:X/tot,y:Y/tot}:{x:.3127,y:.329},gamut);return {x:+p.x.toFixed(6),y:+p.y.toFixed(6)};}
  const css=c=>'rgb('+c.map(v=>Math.round(cap(v,0,1)*255)).join(',')+')';
  return {palettes,shows,defaults,clean,sample,blend,xy,css,colors,getColors,wrap,smooth,trail,hash,lab,unlab};
}
const ENGINE=makeEngine();

 ['event-horizon','Event Horizon','Space','eclipse',16,.65,45,90,80,'A narrow violet crest with darker rests.'],
 ['tidepool','Tidepool','Organic','ripples',8,.6,45,55,40,'Small overlapping turquoise ripples.'],
 ['canopy','Canopy','Organic','nebula',17,.65,50,60,40,'A drifting, layered green canopy.'],
 ['amber-express','Amber Express','Warm','comet',15,.85,60,75,60,'Industrial amber trailing through a cool field.'],
 ['prismatic','Prismatic','Energy','prism',5,.9,70,80,50,'Broad colored bands wrapping the path.'],
 ['subzero','Subzero','Space','scanner',14,.75,55,70,65,'An icy scanner with a soft edge.'],
 ['satellite','Satellite','Space','binary',0,.7,55,65,55,'Two restrained blue/cyan orbiting crests.'],
 ['midweek','Midweek','Chill','director',4,.75,55,65,50,'An evolving set with room to talk.'],
 ['control-room','Control Room','Chill','static',0,.5,40,45,40,'A steady blue foundation for an easy night.']
].map(([id,name,category,show,palette,speed,energy,depth,focus,description])=>({id,name,category,description,
  settings:{showA:show,showB:show,paletteA:palette,paletteB:palette,morph:0,speed,energy,depth,focus,
    saturation:100,ambientFloor:0,accentMix:100,density:1,phaseOffset:0,brightnessCurve:1}}));
function applyLibraryPreset(current,id){const item=PRESET_LIBRARY.find(p=>p.id===id);if(!item)throw new HueError('preset','Unknown built-in preset.');return ENGINE.clean({...current,...item.settings});}
function cleanUiPrefs(raw){const v=raw||{};return {theme:['system','light','dark'].includes(v.theme)?v.theme:'system',motion:['system','reduce'].includes(v.motion)?v.motion:'system',favorites:Array.isArray(v.favorites)?[...new Set(v.favorites.filter(id=>PRESET_LIBRARY.some(p=>p.id===id)))]:[]};}


// ===== hue-layout =====
/** Read-only import of saved Hue Entertainment placement. No streaming or layout writes.
 * Resource identity is explicit: entertainment.renderer_reference -> light.
 * Unique device ownership is a fallback; names, collection order and channel IDs are not.
 */
function huePosition(value) {
  if(!value || !['x','y','z'].every(k=>finite(value[k])&&value[k]>=-1&&value[k]<=1))return null;
  return {x:value.x,y:value.y,z:value.z};
}
function hueMean(points) {
  if(!points.length)return null;
  return {x:points.reduce((n,p)=>n+p.x,0)/points.length,y:points.reduce((n,p)=>n+p.y,0)/points.length,z:points.reduce((n,p)=>n+p.z,0)/points.length};
}
function hueProjection(p,projection='xy',mirror=false) {
  // The SVG map is 312 x 198 units. A single scale keeps both axes isotropic.
  const u=projection==='yz'?p.y:p.x,v=projection==='xy'?p.y:p.z;
  return {x:.5+(mirror?-1:1)*u*88/312,y:.5-v*88/198};
}
function huePhase(p,mode='clockwise') {
  if(['x','y','z'].includes(mode))return (p[mode]+1)/2;
  if(Math.hypot(p.x,p.y)<1e-7)return null; // A centre point has no angular bearing.
  return ((Math.atan2(p.x,p.y)/(2*Math.PI))%1+1)%1;
}
function cleanHuePlacement(raw) {
  if(!raw||typeof raw.areaId!=='string'||!huePosition(raw.position))return null;
  const channels=Array.isArray(raw.channels)?raw.channels.slice(0,256).filter(c=>huePosition(c.position)&&Number.isInteger(c.index)&&c.index>=0).map(c=>({channelId:Number.isInteger(c.channelId)?c.channelId:null,index:c.index,position:huePosition(c.position),shared:c.shared===true})):[];
  return {areaId:raw.areaId.slice(0,128),areaName:String(raw.areaName||'Hue area').slice(0,160),serviceId:String(raw.serviceId||'').slice(0,128),
    source:raw.source==='channel_average'?'channel_average':'service_locations',matchedBy:String(raw.matchedBy||'').slice(0,64),position:huePosition(raw.position),
    positions:(Array.isArray(raw.positions)?raw.positions:[]).slice(0,256).map(huePosition).filter(Boolean),channels,
    equalizationFactor:finite(raw.equalizationFactor)?raw.equalizationFactor:null,fetchedAt:finite(raw.fetchedAt)?raw.fetchedAt:null,
    importedAt:finite(raw.importedAt)?raw.importedAt:null,projection:['xy','xz','yz'].includes(raw.projection)?raw.projection:'xy',mirror:raw.mirror===true,
    phaseMode:['keep','clockwise','x','y','z'].includes(raw.phaseMode)?raw.phaseMode:'keep',
    applied:raw.applied&&['x','y','q'].every(k=>finite(raw.applied[k]))?{x:raw.applied.x,y:raw.applied.y,q:raw.applied.q}:null};
}
function cleanHueLayoutMeta(raw) {
  if(!raw||typeof raw.areaId!=='string')return null;
  return {areaId:raw.areaId.slice(0,128),areaName:String(raw.areaName||'Hue area').slice(0,160),
    projection:['xy','xz','yz'].includes(raw.projection)?raw.projection:'xy',mirror:raw.mirror===true,
    phaseMode:['keep','clockwise','x','y','z'].includes(raw.phaseMode)?raw.phaseMode:'keep',
    fetchedAt:finite(raw.fetchedAt)?raw.fetchedAt:null,importedAt:finite(raw.importedAt)?raw.importedAt:null};
}
function huePlacementText(p) {
  const h=p?.hue;if(!h)return 'Local placement; no Hue coordinates imported.';
  const xyz=h.position,changed=h.applied&&(Math.abs(p.x-h.applied.x)>1e-6||Math.abs(p.y-h.applied.y)>1e-6||Math.abs(p.q-h.applied.q)>1e-6);
  return 'Hue: '+h.areaName+' · XYZ '+[xyz.x,xyz.y,xyz.z].map(n=>n.toFixed(2)).join(', ')+
    ' · '+(h.source==='channel_average'?'channel-average fallback':'saved service geometry')+
    (h.channels.length?' · '+h.channels.length+' channel segment(s)':'')+(changed?' · local placement/path edited':'');
}
function buildHueLayoutCatalog(configurations,entertainments,devices,allLights,scopeLights,fetchedAt=Date.now()) {
  const lightMap=new Map(allLights.filter(l=>typeof l?.id==='string').map(l=>[l.id,l]));
  const scope=new Set(scopeLights.map(l=>l.id)),serviceMap=new Map(entertainments.filter(e=>typeof e?.id==='string').map(e=>[e.id,e]));
  const deviceList=devices.filter(d=>typeof d?.id==='string');
  function resolve(ref,area) {
    if(!ref||typeof ref.rid!=='string')return {error:'Missing service reference'};
    if(ref.rtype==='light')return lightMap.has(ref.rid)?{id:ref.rid,matchedBy:'direct_light'}:{error:'Referenced light is missing'};
    if(ref.rtype!=='entertainment')return {error:'Unsupported reference type: '+String(ref.rtype)};
    const service=serviceMap.get(ref.rid),renderer=service?.renderer_reference;
    if(renderer){
      if(renderer.rtype==='light'&&lightMap.has(renderer.rid))return {id:renderer.rid,matchedBy:'renderer_reference'};
      return {error:'Renderer reference is invalid or its light is missing'}; // Never guess around a broken explicit link.
    }
    const owners=new Set();
    if(service?.owner?.rtype==='device'&&service.owner.rid)owners.add(service.owner.rid);
    for(const d of deviceList)if((d.services||[]).some(r=>r.rtype==='entertainment'&&r.rid===ref.rid))owners.add(d.id);
    if(owners.size!==1)return {error:owners.size?'Conflicting service owners':'No entertainment-to-device link'};
    const owner=[...owners][0],candidateIds=new Set();
    for(const l of lightMap.values())if(l.owner?.rtype==='device'&&l.owner.rid===owner)candidateIds.add(l.id);
    const device=deviceList.find(d=>d.id===owner);
    for(const r of device?.services||[])if(r.rtype==='light'&&lightMap.has(r.rid))candidateIds.add(r.rid);
    if(candidateIds.size!==1)return {error:candidateIds.size?'Ambiguous device with multiple light services':'Owner has no matching light service'};
    return {id:[...candidateIds][0],matchedBy:'unique_device_owner'};
  }
  return configurations.filter(a=>typeof a?.id==='string').map(area=>{
    const warnings=[],services=new Map(),blocked=new Set(),ambiguous=new Set();
    const message=(text)=>{if(warnings.length<80&&!warnings.includes(text))warnings.push(text);};
    const entry=ref=>{
      const key=ref?.rtype+':'+ref?.rid;if(blocked.has(key))return null;
      const resolved=resolve(ref,area);if(resolved.error){message(resolved.error);return null;}
      if(!services.has(key))services.set(key,{lightId:resolved.id,serviceId:ref.rid,matchedBy:resolved.matchedBy,positions:[],channels:[],equalizationFactor:null});
      return services.get(key);
    };
    for(const loc of area.locations?.service_locations||[]) {
      const e=entry(loc.service);if(!e)continue;
      const source=Array.isArray(loc.positions)&&loc.positions.length?loc.positions:loc.position?[loc.position]:[];
      const valid=source.map(huePosition);
      if(!valid.length||valid.some(p=>!p)||valid.length>256){message('Invalid/missing saved service coordinates; no replacement coordinates invented.');continue;}
      if(e.positions.length&&JSON.stringify(e.positions)!==JSON.stringify(valid)){
        blocked.add(loc.service.rtype+':'+loc.service.rid);services.delete(loc.service.rtype+':'+loc.service.rid);ambiguous.add(e.lightId);message('Conflicting service locations were skipped.');continue;
      }
      e.positions=valid;e.equalizationFactor=finite(loc.equalization_factor)?loc.equalization_factor:null;
    }
    for(const ch of area.channels||[]) {
      const position=huePosition(ch.position);if(!position){message('Invalid channel coordinates were skipped.');continue;}
      for(const member of ch.members||[]){const e=entry(member.service);if(!e)continue;
        if(!Number.isInteger(member.index)||member.index<0){message('A channel member has no valid segment index; skipped.');continue;}
        const old=e.channels.find(c=>c.index===member.index);
        if(old&&JSON.stringify(old.position)!==JSON.stringify(position)){ambiguous.add(e.lightId);message('Conflicting channel positions for the same segment were skipped.');continue;}
        if(!old)e.channels.push({channelId:Number.isInteger(ch.channel_id)?ch.channel_id:null,index:member.index,position,shared:ch.members.length>1});
      }
    }
    const mapped=new Map();
    for(const e of services.values()) {
      e.channels.sort((a,b)=>a.index-b.index);
      const base=e.positions.length?e.positions:e.channels.map(c=>c.position);if(!base.length)continue;
      if(!e.positions.length)message('Some placements use channel averages, not individual service geometry.');
      if(e.channels.some(c=>c.shared))message('Shared channel coordinates are member averages; kept separate from service geometry.');
      if(e.matchedBy==='unique_device_owner')message('Some mappings use a unique device-owner fallback; no name/order matching.');
      const record={...e,position:hueMean(base),source:e.positions.length?'service_locations':'channel_average'};
      if(mapped.has(e.lightId)){ambiguous.add(e.lightId);message('More than one entertainment service maps to a light; that light was skipped.');}
      else mapped.set(e.lightId,record);
    }
    for(const id of ambiguous)mapped.delete(id);
    const records=[...mapped.values()].filter(e=>scope.has(e.lightId));
    const unmatched=scopeLights.filter(l=>!mapped.has(l.id)).map(l=>({id:l.id,name:l.label||l.metadata?.name||l.id}));
    return {id:area.id,name:String(area.metadata?.name||area.name||'Unnamed Entertainment area').slice(0,160),
      type:String(area.configuration_type||'other'),active:area.status==='active',fetchedAt,
      records,matched:records.length,total:scopeLights.length,unmatched,outside:[...mapped.keys()].filter(id=>!scope.has(id)).length,
      warnings,channelCount:(area.channels||[]).length};
  }).sort((a,b)=>b.matched-a.matched||a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}
async function fetchHueLayoutCatalog(cfg,scopeLights,request=endpoint,now=()=>Date.now(),cancelled=()=>false) {
  const get=async type=>{if(cancelled())throw new HueError('cancelled','Layout read cancelled.');
    const reply=await request(cfg,'GET',type);if(cancelled())throw new HueError('cancelled','Layout read cancelled.');
    if(!Array.isArray(reply?.data))throw new HueError('protocol','Invalid '+type+' layout response.');return reply.data;};
  const configurations=await get('entertainment_configuration');if(!configurations.length)return [];
  let services=[];try{services=await get('entertainment');}catch(e){if(e.status!==404)throw e;}
  const devices=await get('device'),lights=await get('light');
  return buildHueLayoutCatalog(configurations,services,devices,lights,scopeLights,now());
}
function applyHueLayout(current,lights,area,options={},at=Date.now()) {
  if(!area?.records?.length)throw new HueError('layout','No unambiguous positions in this Entertainment area match the current room.');
  const layout=cleanLayout(current,lights),projection=['xy','xz','yz'].includes(options.projection)?options.projection:'xy';
  const phaseMode=['keep','clockwise','x','y','z'].includes(options.phaseMode)?options.phaseMode:'clockwise',mirror=options.mirror===true;
  for(const r of area.records) {
    if(!layout.placements[r.lightId]||!huePosition(r.position))continue;
    const p=layout.placements[r.lightId],xy=hueProjection(r.position,projection,mirror),phase=phaseMode==='keep'?null:huePhase(r.position,phaseMode);
    p.x=xy.x;p.y=xy.y;if(phase!==null)p.q=phase;
    p.hue=cleanHuePlacement({areaId:area.id,areaName:area.name,serviceId:r.serviceId,source:r.source,matchedBy:r.matchedBy,
      position:r.position,positions:r.positions,channels:r.channels,equalizationFactor:r.equalizationFactor,
      fetchedAt:area.fetchedAt,importedAt:at,projection,phaseMode,mirror,applied:{x:p.x,y:p.y,q:p.q}});
  }
  layout.hue=cleanHueLayoutMeta({areaId:area.id,areaName:area.name,projection,mirror,phaseMode,fetchedAt:area.fetchedAt,importedAt:at});
  return layout;
}


// ===== model =====
/** Capability, layout and static restoration models. */
function capabilities(light) {
  const v2=light.effects_v2?.action?.effect_values;
  const legacy=light.effects?.effect_values;
  const sc=light.color_temperature?.mirek_schema;
  const temperatureRange=sc&&finite(sc.mirek_minimum)&&finite(sc.mirek_maximum)&&sc.mirek_minimum>0&&sc.mirek_maximum>=sc.mirek_minimum?{min:Math.ceil(1000000/sc.mirek_maximum),max:Math.floor(1000000/sc.mirek_minimum)}:null;
  return {power:typeof light.on?.on==='boolean',color:!!light.color,dimming:!!light.dimming,temperature:!!light.color_temperature,temperatureRange,minBrightness:finite(light.dimming?.min_dim_level)?light.dimming.min_dim_level:null,
    dynamic:light.dynamics?.status_values?.includes('dynamic_palette')===true,
    gradient:Math.min(5,Math.max(0,Number(light.gradient?.points_capable)||0)),
    effects:(Array.isArray(v2)?v2:Array.isArray(legacy)?legacy:[]).filter(x=>typeof x==='string'),
    effectsV2:Array.isArray(v2),streaming:light.mode==='streaming'};
}
function cleanLayout(raw,lights) {
  const src=raw&&typeof raw==='object'?raw:{},ids=lights.map(l=>l.id), valid=new Set(ids);
  const order=Array.isArray(src.order)?[...new Set(src.order.filter(id=>valid.has(id)))]:[];
  for(const id of ids)if(!order.includes(id))order.push(id);
  const selected=Array.isArray(src.selected)?[...new Set(src.selected.filter(id=>valid.has(id)))]:lights.filter(l=>l.color).map(l=>l.id);
  const placements={};
  for(const [index,id] of order.entries()) {
    const q=index/Math.max(1,order.length),p=src.placements?.[id]||{};
    const num=(k,lo,hi,d)=>finite(p[k])?clamp(p[k],lo,hi):d;
    placements[id]={q:num('q',0,1,q),x:num('x',.04,.96,.5+.37*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*q)),y:num('y',.06,.94,.5-.32*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*q)),
      role:['wash','accent','task','anchor'].includes(p.role)?p.role:lights.find(l=>l.id===id)?.color?'wash':'task',trim:num('trim',.1,1,1),ceiling:num('ceiling',5,100,100),
      stripReverse:p.stripReverse===true,extent:num('extent',.02,.5,.18),angle:num('angle',-180,180,0)};
  }
  for(const id of order){const h=cleanHuePlacement(src.placements?.[id]?.hue);if(h)placements[id].hue=h;}
  const hue=cleanHueLayoutMeta(src.hue);
  return {order,selected,placements,...(hue?{hue}:{})};
}
function orderedLights(cfg,group) {
  const raw=cfg.orders?.[group.id]||[],byId=new Map(group.lights.map(l=>[l.id,l]));
  const ids=[...new Set(Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[])].filter(id=>byId.has(id));
  const remaining=group.lights.filter(l=>!ids.includes(l.id)).sort((a,b)=>a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
  return ids.map(id=>byId.get(id)).concat(remaining);
}
function stopEffect(light) {
  const c=capabilities(light);
  if(c.effects.includes('no_effect'))return c.effectsV2?{effects_v2:{action:{effect:'no_effect'}}}:{effects:{effect:'no_effect'}};
  return {};
}
function snapshotAction(light) {
  if(!light?.on||typeof light.on.on!=='boolean')throw new HueError('protocol','Cannot capture an incomplete light state.');
  const a={on:{on:light.on.on},...(light.dimming?{dynamics:{duration:1500}}:{}),...stopEffect(light)};
  if(finite(light.dimming?.brightness))a.dimming={brightness:clamp(light.dimming.brightness,.1,100)};
  // Temperature validity wins over leftover gradient values from an older command.
  if(light.color_temperature?.mirek_valid&&finite(light.color_temperature.mirek))a.color_temperature={mirek:light.color_temperature.mirek};
  else if(light.gradient?.points?.length>=2){a.gradient={points:clone(light.gradient.points)};if(light.gradient.mode)a.gradient.mode=light.gradient.mode;}
  else if(light.color?.xy)a.color={xy:clone(light.color.xy)};
  return a;
}
function validatedSnapshot(action,light) {
  if(!action||typeof action.on?.on!=='boolean')return null;
  const a={on:{on:action.on.on},...(light.dimming?{dynamics:{duration:1500}}:{}),...stopEffect(light)};
  if(finite(action.dimming?.brightness)&&light.dimming)a.dimming={brightness:clamp(action.dimming.brightness,.1,100)};
  const point=p=>p&&finite(p.x)&&finite(p.y)&&p.x>=0&&p.y>0&&p.x+p.y<=1.001;
  if(finite(action.color_temperature?.mirek)&&light.color_temperature){const s=light.color_temperature.mirek_schema||{};a.color_temperature={mirek:Math.round(clamp(action.color_temperature.mirek,s.mirek_minimum||153,s.mirek_maximum||500))};}
  else if(light.gradient&&Array.isArray(action.gradient?.points)&&action.gradient.points.length>=2&&action.gradient.points.every(p=>point(p.color?.xy))){a.gradient={points:action.gradient.points.slice(0,Math.max(2,light.gradient.points_capable||5)).map(p=>({color:{xy:{x:p.color.xy.x,y:p.color.xy.y}}}))};if(light.gradient.mode_values?.includes(action.gradient.mode))a.gradient.mode=action.gradient.mode;}
  else if(light.color&&point(action.color?.xy))a.color={xy:{x:action.color.xy.x,y:action.color.xy.y}};
  return a;
}
function fixtureSample(t,placement,settings,surge=0) {
  let f=ENGINE.sample(t,placement.q,settings,surge);
  if(placement.role==='task')f={rgb:[.92,.94,1],b:settings.brightness*.72};
  else if(placement.role==='anchor')f={rgb:ENGINE.getColors(settings,settings.paletteA)[0],b:settings.brightness*.46};
  else if(placement.role==='wash')f.b=f.b*.7+settings.brightness*.18;
  f.b=clamp(f.b*placement.trim,.1,Math.min(settings.brightness,placement.ceiling,100));return f;
}
function actionFromFrame(light,frame,placement,settings,duration,on=false,gradientFrames=null) {
  const a={dimming:{brightness:+clamp(frame.b,.1,Math.min(settings.brightness,placement.ceiling,100)).toFixed(2)},dynamics:{duration:Math.round(duration/100)*100}};
  if(on)a.on={on:true};
  if(placement.role==='task'&&light.color_temperature){const sc=light.color_temperature.mirek_schema||{};a.color_temperature={mirek:clamp(250,sc.mirek_minimum||153,sc.mirek_maximum||500)};}
  else if(light.color)a.color={xy:ENGINE.xy(frame.rgb,light.color.gamut)};
  if(gradientFrames?.length>=2&&light.gradient&&placement.role!=='task') {
    a.gradient={points:gradientFrames.map(f=>({color:{xy:ENGINE.xy(f.rgb,light.color?.gamut)}}))};
    if(light.gradient.mode_values?.includes('interpolated_palette'))a.gradient.mode='interpolated_palette';delete a.color;
  }
  return a;
}
function effectAction(light,effect,settings,placement) {
  const c=capabilities(light);if(!c.effects.includes(effect)||effect==='no_effect')throw new HueError('unsupported','This fixture does not advertise the selected effect.');
  const a={on:{on:true},dimming:{brightness:Math.min(settings.brightness*placement.trim,placement.ceiling,100)}};
  if(c.effectsV2){a.effects_v2={action:{effect}};const reported=light.effects_v2.status;
    // Parameter availability is advertised conservatively by readback for this effect.
    if(reported?.effect===effect&&reported.parameters){const parameters={};if(finite(reported.parameters.speed))parameters.speed=settings.effectSpeed;
      if(settings.effectTint&&reported.parameters.color&&light.color)parameters.color={xy:ENGINE.xy(ENGINE.getColors(settings,settings.paletteA)[1],light.color.gamut)};
      if(Object.keys(parameters).length)a.effects_v2.action.parameters=parameters;}
  } else a.effects={effect};return a;
}
function availableEffects(lights,layout) {
  const chosen=lights.filter(l=>layout.selected.includes(l.id)&&l.mode!=='streaming'&&!['task','anchor'].includes(layout.placements[l.id].role));
  const names=[...new Set(chosen.flatMap(l=>capabilities(l).effects))].filter(n=>n!=='no_effect'&&n!=='unknown');
  return names.map(name=>({name,supported:chosen.filter(l=>capabilities(l).effects.includes(name)).length,total:chosen.length})).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}
/** Absolute deadlines with adaptive latency budgeting. No queued animation frames. */
class DeadlinePlanner {
  constructor(){this.due=new Map();this.lastStart=-Infinity;this.latency=100;this.horizon=4500;this.samples=[];}
  plan(ids,now) {
    // Budget for the 120 ms UI loop plus native evaluation/dispatch overhead.
    // RTT alone underestimates a full pass when many lights are selected.
    const slot=Math.max(350,this.latency*1.35+80),wakeBudget=180;
    const cycle=Math.max(4200,ids.length*(slot+wakeBudget));
    this.horizon=Math.max(4500,cycle*1.18+this.latency*1.5+300);
    if(this.horizon>60000)return {overloaded:true,horizon:this.horizon};
    if(now-this.lastStart<slot)return null;
    for(const id of ids)if(!this.due.has(id))this.due.set(id,now);
    let id=null,earliest=Infinity;for(const candidate of ids){const d=this.due.get(candidate);if(d<earliest){earliest=d;id=candidate;}}
    if(!id||earliest>now)return null;
    return {id,cycle,horizon:this.horizon,lateness:Math.max(0,now-earliest)};
  }
  start(id,now,cycle){this.lastStart=now;this.due.set(id,now+cycle);}
  complete(start,finish){const elapsed=Math.max(0,finish-start);this.latency=this.latency*.75+elapsed*.25;this.samples.push(elapsed);if(this.samples.length>100)this.samples.shift();}
  reset(ids,now){this.due.clear();ids.forEach((id,i)=>this.due.set(id,now+i*350));this.lastStart=-Infinity;}
}


// ===== daily =====
/** Explicit everyday light intents. Never trusts browser-supplied Hue payloads. */
function validateManualIntent(raw, allowed) {
  if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||!Array.isArray(raw.ids))throw new HueError('validation','Choose at least one light.');
  const ids=[...new Set(raw.ids.filter(id=>typeof id==='string'))];
  if(!ids.length||ids.some(id=>!allowed.has(id)))throw new HueError('selection','One or more lights are outside this area. Nothing was sent.');
  const intent={ids};
  if(raw.on!==undefined){if(typeof raw.on!=='boolean')throw new HueError('validation','Power must be on or off.');intent.on=raw.on;}
  if(raw.brightness!==undefined){if(!finite(raw.brightness)||raw.brightness<.1||raw.brightness>100)throw new HueError('validation','Brightness must be greater than zero and at most 100%. Use Off to switch lights off.');intent.brightness=raw.brightness;}
  if(raw.kelvin!==undefined){if(!finite(raw.kelvin)||raw.kelvin<1000||raw.kelvin>10000)throw new HueError('validation','Invalid white temperature.');intent.kelvin=raw.kelvin;}
  if(raw.hex!==undefined){if(typeof raw.hex!=='string'||!/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(raw.hex))throw new HueError('validation','Choose a six-digit color.');intent.hex=raw.hex;}
  if(intent.hex&&intent.kelvin)throw new HueError('validation','Choose color or white temperature, not both.');
  if(Object.keys(intent).length===1)throw new HueError('validation','No lighting change was selected.');
  if(intent.on===false&&Object.keys(intent).length>2)throw new HueError('validation','An Off command must not also change brightness or color.');
  return intent;
}
function manualAction(light, placement, intent) {
  const cap=capabilities(light),p=placement||{ceiling:100,trim:1};
  if(cap.streaming)throw new HueError('ownership','A streaming app owns this light. Stop it there first.');
  // A mixed room must never turn on unrelated switches merely because a white/color preset was used.
  if(intent.kelvin!==undefined&&!cap.temperature)return null;
  if(intent.hex!==undefined&&!cap.color)return null;
  if(intent.brightness!==undefined&&!cap.dimming)return null;
  const action={};
  if(intent.on!==undefined)action.on={on:intent.on};
  if(intent.on===false)return action;
  const ceiling=clamp(p.ceiling,5,100),trim=clamp(p.trim,.1,1);
  const minimum=Math.max(.1,Math.min(100,finite(light.dimming?.min_dim_level)?light.dimming.min_dim_level:.1));
  const bounded=value=>{if(ceiling<minimum)throw new HueError('validation','This light’s ceiling is below its advertised minimum dim level.');return +clamp(value*trim,minimum,ceiling).toFixed(2);};
  // Take a one-time static appearance when turning on, so a delegated effect does not keep fighting the control.
  if(intent.on===true&&cap.dimming){if(ceiling<minimum)throw new HueError('validation','This light’s ceiling is below its advertised minimum dim level.');if(!finite(light.dimming?.brightness)&&intent.brightness===undefined)throw new HueError('protocol','Current brightness is unavailable. Set a brightness explicitly.');action.dimming={brightness:+clamp(finite(light.dimming?.brightness)?light.dimming.brightness:minimum,minimum,ceiling).toFixed(2)};}
  if(intent.brightness!==undefined)action.dimming={brightness:bounded(intent.brightness)};
  if(intent.kelvin!==undefined){
    const sc=light.color_temperature?.mirek_schema;
    if(!sc||!finite(sc.mirek_minimum)||!finite(sc.mirek_maximum)||sc.mirek_minimum<=0||sc.mirek_maximum<sc.mirek_minimum)throw new HueError('unsupported','The Bridge did not advertise a valid white-temperature range.');
    action.color_temperature={mirek:Math.round(clamp(1000000/intent.kelvin,sc.mirek_minimum,sc.mirek_maximum))};
  } else if(intent.hex!==undefined){const rgb=[1,3,5].map(i=>parseInt(intent.hex.slice(i,i+2),16)/255);action.color={xy:ENGINE.xy(rgb,light.color.gamut)};}
  if(cap.dimming)action.dynamics={duration:700};
  return {...action,...stopEffect(light)};
}


// ===== hue =====
/** HTTPS transport and identity-aware pairing. Keys never enter either UI model. */
async function http(ip,method,path,payload,key) {
  if(!validIp(ip))throw new HueError('validation','Use a private LAN IPv4 Bridge address.');
  const r=new Request('https://'+ip+path);r.method=method;r.timeoutInterval=5;r.allowInsecureRequest=true;r.onRedirect=()=>null;
  const headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json'};if(key)headers['hue-application-key']=key;r.headers=headers;
  if(payload!==undefined)r.body=JSON.stringify(payload);
  let raw;try{raw=await r.loadString();}catch(_){throw new HueError('network','Cannot reach the Bridge. Check Wi-Fi, Local Network permission and the Bridge address.');}
  const code=r.response?.statusCode||0;
  if(code===401||code===403)throw new HueError('auth','Bridge authorization was rejected (HTTP '+code+'). The existing key has not been deleted.',code);
  if(code===429)throw new HueError('rate','Bridge asked the controller to slow down (HTTP 429).',code);
  if(code>=300&&code<400)throw new HueError('redirect','Bridge redirect was rejected to protect your key.',code);
  let data;try{data=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{};}catch(_){throw new HueError('protocol','Bridge returned non-JSON (HTTP '+code+').',code);}
  const details=Array.isArray(data.errors)?data.errors:[];
  if(code>=400||details.length){const desc=details.map(v=>v.description||'Hue error').join('; ');throw new HueError(code===404?'missing':code>=500?'server':'api',desc||'Bridge request failed (HTTP '+code+').',code,details);}
  return data;
}
function authName(cfg){return cfg.bridgeId?'hue-board.bridgekey.'+cfg.bridgeId:AUTH_PREFIX+cfg.ip;}
function endpoint(cfg,method,path,payload){const name=authName(cfg);if(!Keychain.contains(name))throw new HueError('auth','No saved Bridge key. Run pairing from the main menu.');return http(cfg.ip,method,'/clip/v2/resource/'+path,payload,Keychain.get(name));}
function readConfig(){migrateLegacyState();return Object.assign({orders:{}},readObject(STORAGE,{}));}
function saveConfig(cfg){writeObject(STORAGE,cfg);}
async function bridgeSetup(cfg,force=false) {
  if(validIp(cfg.ip)&&!force)return true;
  let ips=[];try{const r=new Request('https://discovery.meethue.com/');r.timeoutInterval=5;const data=await r.loadJSON();ips=[...new Set((Array.isArray(data)?data:[]).map(v=>v.internalipaddress).filter(validIp))];}catch(_){}
  const pick=await choose('Choose Hue Bridge','Use trusted home Wi-Fi. Local Hue certificate verification is disabled in this Scriptable implementation.',ips.map(ip=>'Bridge '+ip).concat('Enter IP manually'),'Cancel');if(pick<0)return false;
  const ip=pick<ips.length?ips[pick]:await input('Bridge IP','Find the local IP in the Hue app.',cfg.ip||'');if(ip===null)return false;if(!validIp(ip))throw new HueError('validation','Invalid private LAN IPv4 address.');
  cfg.ip=ip;saveConfig(cfg);return true;
}
async function ensurePairing(cfg) {
  // Preserve a known identity until a new address has answered. Never send its key blindly.
  let probe;
  for(;;){try{probe=await http(cfg.ip,'GET','/api/config');if(!probe||!(probe.bridgeid||probe.modelid||probe.apiversion))throw new HueError('protocol','This address did not identify itself as a Hue Bridge.');break;}
    catch(e){const action=await choose('Bridge connection',shortError(e),['Retry address','Choose another address'],'Cancel');if(action<0)return false;if(action===1&&!await bridgeSetup(cfg,true))return false;}}
  const previous=cfg.bridgeId;
  const publicId=typeof probe.bridgeid==='string'?probe.bridgeid.toLowerCase():null;
  if(publicId&&previous&&publicId!==previous){delete cfg.group;}
  if(publicId)cfg.bridgeId=publicId;else if(previous&&cfg.knownIp!==cfg.ip)delete cfg.bridgeId;
  const canonical=authName(cfg);
  migrateLegacyBridgeKey(cfg);
  for(;;){if(Keychain.contains(canonical)){
      try {const result=await endpoint(cfg,'GET','bridge');const bridge=result.data?.[0];if(!bridge)throw new HueError('protocol','Bridge validation returned no bridge resource.');
        const id=typeof bridge.bridge_id==='string'?bridge.bridge_id.toLowerCase():publicId||bridge.id;
        if(publicId&&bridge.bridge_id&&id!==publicId)throw new HueError('identity','Bridge identity changed during authorization.');
        const key=Keychain.get(canonical);cfg.bridgeId=id;cfg.knownIp=cfg.ip;Keychain.set(authName(cfg),key);saveConfig(cfg);return true;
      } catch(e){if(errorKind(e)!=='auth'){
          const action=await choose('Connection check failed',shortError(e)+'\n\nThis is not evidence that pairing was lost.', ['Retry connection','Change Bridge address'],'Cancel');if(action<0)return false;if(action===1){if(!await bridgeSetup(cfg,true))return false;return ensurePairing(cfg);}continue;}
        const action=await choose('Pairing required',shortError(e),['Pair using Bridge button'],'Cancel');if(action<0)return false;}
    }
    const action=await choose('Pair with the Bridge','Press its physical center button, then tap Pair now. No lights or scenes will be removed.', ['Pair now'],'Cancel');if(action<0)return false;
    const reply=await http(cfg.ip,'POST','/api',{devicetype:'hue_board#iphone'});const key=reply?.[0]?.success?.username;
    if(typeof key==='string'&&key.length>=8){Keychain.set(canonical,key);continue;}
    await inform('Pairing not granted',String(reply?.[0]?.error?.description||'No key returned. Press the button and try again.'));
  }
}
async function inventory(cfg) {
  const result=await Promise.all(['room','zone','light','device'].map(p=>endpoint(cfg,'GET',p)));
  for(const r of result)if(!Array.isArray(r.data))throw new HueError('protocol','Invalid inventory response.');
  const [rooms,zones,raw,ds]=result.map(r=>r.data),devices=new Map(ds.map(d=>[d.id,d]));
  const ls=raw.filter(l=>typeof l?.id==='string'&&typeof l.on?.on==='boolean');
  const labels=new Map();for(const l of ls){const d=devices.get(l.owner?.rid),n=l.metadata?.name||d?.metadata?.name||'Light '+l.id.slice(0,6);labels.set(n,(labels.get(n)||0)+1);}
  const lights=ls.map(l=>{const d=devices.get(l.owner?.rid),name=l.metadata?.name||d?.metadata?.name||'Light '+l.id.slice(0,6);
    return {...l,label:name+(labels.get(name)>1?' · '+l.id.slice(0,4):''),deviceLabel:d?.metadata?.name||'',model:d?.product_data?.model_id||'',capabilities:capabilities(l)};});
  const groups=rooms.concat(zones).map(g=>{const children=new Set((g.children||[]).map(c=>c.rid));return {id:g.id,type:g.type,name:g.metadata?.name||'Unnamed area',lights:lights.filter(l=>children.has(l.id)||children.has(l.owner?.rid))};}).filter(g=>g.lights.length).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  // A local view, never submitted as a real Hue room or scene group.
  if(lights.length)groups.unshift({id:'all-lights',type:'all',name:'All lights',lights});
  return groups;
}
function getGroup(cfg,groups){return groups.find(g=>g.id===cfg.group?.rid&&g.type===cfg.group?.rtype);}
async function selectGroup(cfg,groups){const i=await choose('Choose lighting area','Choose the lights you want to manage. Opening an area does not change them.',groups.map(g=>g.name+' · '+g.lights.length+' lights'));if(i<0)return false;cfg.group={rid:groups[i].id,rtype:groups[i].type};saveConfig(cfg);return true;}


// ===== telemetry =====
function makeTelemetryTools() {
  const finite = v => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
  const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  function point(v) {
    return v && finite(v.x) && finite(v.y) && v.x>=0 && v.y>0 && v.x+v.y<=1.001
      ? {x:v.x,y:v.y} : null;
  }
  function normalize(light, fetchedAt) {
    const temp=light.color_temperature;
    return {id:light.id, owner:light.owner && light.owner.rid || null, fetchedAt, missing:false,
      on:light.on && typeof light.on.on==='boolean' ? light.on.on : null,
      brightness:light.dimming && finite(light.dimming.brightness) ? clamp(light.dimming.brightness,0,100) : null,
      xy:point(light.color && light.color.xy),
      kelvin:temp && temp.mirek_valid===true && finite(temp.mirek) && temp.mirek>0 ? Math.round(1000000/temp.mirek) : null,
      gradient:((light.gradient && Array.isArray(light.gradient.points)) ? light.gradient.points : []).slice(0,64).map(p=>point(p.color && p.color.xy)).filter(Boolean),
      dynamics:light.dynamics && typeof light.dynamics.status==='string' ? light.dynamics.status : null,
      effect:light.effects_v2 && light.effects_v2.status && typeof light.effects_v2.status.effect==='string' ? light.effects_v2.status.effect : light.effects && typeof light.effects.status==='string' ? light.effects.status : null,
      mode:typeof light.mode==='string' ? light.mode : null};
  }
  function xyCSS(p) {
    p=point(p); if(!p)return '#8a99a5';
    const X=p.x/p.y, Y=1, Z=(1-p.x-p.y)/p.y;
    let rgb=[3.2406*X-1.5372*Y-0.4986*Z,-0.9689*X+1.8758*Y+0.0415*Z,0.0557*X-0.2040*Y+1.0570*Z].map(v=>Math.max(0,v));
    const scale=Math.max(1,...rgb); rgb=rgb.map(v=>v/scale);
    const channel=v=>Math.round(255*clamp(v<=0.0031308?12.92*v:1.055*Math.pow(v,1/2.4)-0.055,0,1));
    return 'rgb('+rgb.map(channel).join(',')+')';
  }
  function age(stamp, now) {return finite(stamp) ? Math.max(0,(now-stamp)/1000) : null;}
  function ageText(stamp, now) {const a=age(stamp,now);return a===null?'not read':Math.floor(a)+'s ago';}
  function connection(entry, now) {
    if(!entry || !finite(entry.fetchedAt) || age(entry.fetchedAt,now)>30)return 'link unknown';
    const labels={connected:'link connected',disconnected:'link disconnected',connectivity_issue:'link issue',unidirectional_incoming:'one-way link',pending_discovery:'discovery pending'};
    return labels[entry.status] || 'link unknown';
  }
  function stateText(row) {
    if(!row)return 'No Bridge read yet';
    if(row.missing)return 'Missing from latest Bridge response';
    const bits=[row.on===true?'On':row.on===false?'Off':'Power unknown'];
    if(finite(row.brightness))bits.push(Math.round(row.brightness)+'%'+(row.on===false?' stored':' brightness'));
    if(row.kelvin)bits.push(row.kelvin+' K');
    else if(row.xy)bits.push('xy '+row.xy.x.toFixed(3)+', '+row.xy.y.toFixed(3));
    if(row.gradient && row.gradient.length)bits.push(row.gradient.length+' gradient points');
    if(row.dynamics && row.dynamics!=='none')bits.push(row.dynamics);
    if(row.effect && row.effect!=='no_effect')bits.push(row.effect);
    if(row.mode==='streaming')bits.push('streaming');
    return bits.join(' · ');
  }
  function targetText(target, now) {
    if(!target)return 'No target sent this session';
    if(target.kind==='native')return 'Native palette recall accepted '+ageText(target.acceptedAt,now)+'; no single color target';
    const a=target.action || {}, bits=[target.kind==='restore'?'Restore accepted':'Target accepted',ageText(target.acceptedAt,now)];
    if(a.on && typeof a.on.on==='boolean')bits.push(a.on.on?'On':'Off');
    if(a.dimming && finite(a.dimming.brightness))bits.push(Math.round(a.dimming.brightness)+'%');
    if(a.color && point(a.color.xy))bits.push('xy '+a.color.xy.x.toFixed(3)+', '+a.color.xy.y.toFixed(3));
    if(a.gradient && Array.isArray(a.gradient.points))bits.push(a.gradient.points.length+' gradient points');
    return bits.join(' · ');
  }
  function summary(telem, now) {
    if(!telem)return 'Waiting for the first Bridge read';
    let text=telem.lastRead==null?'Waiting for the first Bridge read':'Bridge read '+ageText(telem.lastRead,now);
    if(telem.lastRead!=null && age(telem.lastRead,now)>6)text+=' · STALE';
    if(telem.error)text+=' · '+telem.error;
    return text;
  }
  function color(row) {
    if(!row || row.missing || row.on!==true)return '#273442';
    // White-temperature mode is labeled numerically, not painted as a false calibrated tint.
    if(row.kelvin)return '#d8dde1';
    return xyCSS(row.gradient && row.gradient.length ? row.gradient[0] : row.xy);
  }
  return {normalize,point,xyCSS,age,ageText,connection,stateText,targetText,summary,color};
}
const TELEMETRY=makeTelemetryTools();

function makeTelemetryMonitor(cfg, lights, request=endpoint, now=()=>Date.now(), onData=()=>{}) {
  const ids=new Set(lights.map(l=>l.id));
  const model={revision:0,lastRead:null,latencyMs:null,error:'',connectivityError:'',readCount:0,data:{},links:{},targets:{}};
  let closed=false, pending=false, nextLights=0, nextLinks=0, lightFailures=0, linkFailures=0;
  function noteAccepted(id, action, kind='live') {
    if(closed || !ids.has(id))return;
    model.targets[id]={acceptedAt:now(),kind,action:kind==='native'?null:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(action))};model.revision++;
  }
  function tick() {
    if(closed || pending)return;
    const stamp=now(), kind=stamp>=nextLights?'light':stamp>=nextLinks?'zigbee_connectivity':null;
    if(!kind)return;
    pending=true;
    // At most one read in flight. This promise never blocks the UI or write loop.
    Promise.resolve().then(()=>request(cfg,'GET',kind)).then(result=>{
      if(closed)return;
      if(!result || !Array.isArray(result.data))throw new Error('Malformed telemetry response');
      const finished=now();
      if(kind==='light') {
        const returned=new Set();
        for(const light of result.data)if(light && ids.has(light.id)) {
          model.data[light.id]=TELEMETRY.normalize(light,finished);returned.add(light.id);
        }
        for(const id of ids)if(!returned.has(id))model.data[id]={...(model.data[id]||{id,fetchedAt:null}),missing:true};
        onData(result.data.filter(l=>l && ids.has(l.id)),finished,stamp);
        model.lastRead=finished;model.latencyMs=Math.max(0,finished-stamp);model.error='';model.readCount++;
        lightFailures=0;nextLights=finished+2000;
      } else {
        const links={};
        for(const link of result.data)if(link && link.owner && typeof link.owner.rid==='string' && typeof link.status==='string')
          links[link.owner.rid]={status:link.status,fetchedAt:finished};
        model.links=links;model.connectivityError='';linkFailures=0;nextLinks=finished+10000;
      }
      model.revision++;
    }).catch(error=>{
      if(closed)return;
      const message=String(error && error.message || error).slice(0,220);
      if(kind==='light') {model.error=message;lightFailures++;nextLights=now()+Math.min(30000,2000*Math.pow(2,Math.min(lightFailures,4)));}
      else {model.connectivityError=message;linkFailures++;nextLinks=now()+Math.min(60000,10000*Math.pow(2,Math.min(linkFailures,3)));}
      model.revision++;
    }).finally(()=>{pending=false;});
  }
  function noteReply(id,action,kind,reply,expectedRid=id) {
    if(reply && Array.isArray(reply.data) && reply.data.some(item=>item && item.rid===expectedRid))noteAccepted(id,action,kind);
  }
  return {tick,noteAccepted,noteReply,snapshot:()=>model,stop:()=>{closed=true;},isPending:()=>pending};
}



// ===== controller =====
/** Shared state machine for both interfaces. UI intent never awaits the network writer. */
function makeController(cfg,group,options={}) {
  const now=options.now||(()=>Date.now()),api=options.api||endpoint;
  const read=options.read||readObject,save=options.save||writeObject,newId=options.uid||uid;
  const lights=orderedLights(cfg,group).filter(l=>typeof l.on?.on==='boolean'),byId=new Map(lights.map(l=>[l.id,l]));
  if(!lights.length)throw new HueError('validation','This area has no controllable lights.');
  const area=(cfg.bridgeId||cfg.ip)+'/'+group.type+'/'+group.id;
  const store=read(V3_STORE,{}),legacy=read(LEGACY_KEYS.olderWorkspace,{})[cfg.ip+'/'+group.id]||{};
  const stored=store[area]||legacy;
  let layoutUndo=stored.layoutUndo?{layout:cleanLayout(stored.layoutUndo.layout,lights),topology:stored.layoutUndo.topology==='path'?'path':'ring'}:null;
  let layoutCatalog=[],layoutJob=null,layoutAttempted=false;
  const layoutRead={pending:false,error:'',fetchedAt:null,revision:0};
  let ui=cleanUiPrefs(stored.ui),sequence={enabled:false,armed:false,index:0,cycle:0,nextAt:0},activeSeconds=0;
  let settings=ENGINE.clean(stored.settings),layout=cleanLayout(stored.layout||stored,lights);
  const presets=Array.isArray(stored.presets)?stored.presets.slice(0,20):[];
  const rooms=Array.isArray(stored.rooms)?stored.rooms.slice(0,12):[];
  let manualResult=null,sceneList=[],scenesPending=false,scenesReadAt=null,scenesError='',sceneJob=null;
  const journal=read(V3_SESSION,{});journal.current=journal.current||{};journal.history=Array.isArray(journal.history)?journal.history:[];
  let session=journal.current[area];
  if(!session||session.bridgeId!==(cfg.bridgeId||cfg.ip)||session.group!==group.id){
    const old=read(LEGACY_KEYS.olderRestore,{})[cfg.ip+'/'+group.id];
    session={id:newId(),bridgeId:cfg.bridgeId||cfg.ip,group:group.id,groupType:group.type,createdAt:now(),states:{},delegated:{},legacy:false};
    if(old?.ip===cfg.ip&&old?.group===group.id&&Array.isArray(old.states)){
      for(const e of old.states){const l=byId.get(e.id);if(!l)continue;const action=validatedSnapshot(e.action,l);if(action)session.states[e.id]={action,capturedAt:null,touchedAt:null};}
      if(Object.keys(session.states).length){session.legacy=true;session.createdAt=null;}
    }
  }
  session.states=session.states||{};session.delegated=session.delegated||{};
  // Sanitize persistence: never replay arbitrary payloads from an old saved file.
  for(const id of Object.keys(session.states)){const l=byId.get(id),a=l&&validatedSnapshot(session.states[id]?.action,l);if(a)session.states[id]={...session.states[id],action:a};else delete session.states[id];}
  for(const id of Object.keys(session.delegated))if(!byId.has(id))delete session.delegated[id];
  let recoveryRequired=Object.keys(session.states).length>0;
  const sceneRegistry=read(V3_SCENES,{});
  let mode=Object.keys(session.delegated).length?'detached':'idle',closed=false,epoch=0,job=null,pending=null;
  let elapsed=0,lastTick=now(),lastPrefs='',lastSave=0,controlError='',note='Ready. Opening the deck does not change lights.';
  let transitionAt=now(),fromFrames={},fromGradient={},surgeAt=-Infinity;
  let readRevision=0,sent=0,totalFailures=0,networkFailures=0,failures={},held={},activated={},lastOwn={},offChecks={};
  let requested={},logs=[],jobStarted=0,quarantined=false,lastSend=-Infinity,lastObservedAt=null,restoreFailures=[];
  let badGradients=new Set(),planner=new DeadlinePlanner();
  const stats={writes:0,readErrors:0,maxConcurrentWriters:0,currentWriters:0,missedDeadlines:0};
  function log(kind,message,id=null){logs.push({at:now(),kind,message:shortError(message),lamp:id?layout.order.indexOf(id)+1:null});if(logs.length>60)logs.shift();}
  function persist(){journal.current[area]=clone(session);save(V3_SESSION,journal);}
  function persistPrefs(force=false){const data={schema:3,settings,layout,presets,rooms,layoutUndo,ui},s=JSON.stringify(data);if(s!==lastPrefs&&(force||now()-lastSave>=1000)){store[area]=data;save(V3_STORE,store);lastPrefs=s;lastSave=now();}}
  function isCurrent(token){return !closed&&token===epoch;}
  function check(token){if(!isCurrent(token))throw new HueError('cancelled','Superseded by a newer control action.');}
  function surge(at=now()){const t=(at-surgeAt)/1000;return t>=0&&t<12?Math.sin(Math.PI*t/12)**2:0;}
  function desired(id,t=elapsed,at=now()){
    const p=layout.placements[id],f=fixtureSample(t,p,settings,surge(at));
    return fromFrames[id]?ENGINE.blend(fromFrames[id],f,ENGINE.smooth((at-transitionAt)/settings.transitionMs)):f;
  }
  function gradients(id,t=elapsed,at=now()){
    const l=byId.get(id),p=layout.placements[id],n=capabilities(l).gradient;if(!settings.gradient||n<2||badGradients.has(id)||p.role==='task')return null;
    return Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>{const f=fixtureSample(t,{...p,q:p.q+(p.stripReverse?-1:1)*(i/(n-1)-.5)*p.extent},settings,surge(at));
      return fromGradient[id]?.[i]?ENGINE.blend(fromGradient[id][i],f,ENGINE.smooth((at-transitionAt)/settings.transitionMs)):f;});
  }
  function freezeForEdit(){const f={},g={};for(const l of lights){f[l.id]=desired(l.id);g[l.id]=gradients(l.id);}fromFrames=f;fromGradient=g;transitionAt=now();}
  function update(packet,fromSequence=false) {
    if(packet.ui){ui=cleanUiPrefs(packet.ui);persistPrefs();}
    const nextS=ENGINE.clean(packet.settings||settings),nextL=cleanLayout(packet.layout||layout,lights);
    if(JSON.stringify(nextS)!==JSON.stringify(settings)||JSON.stringify(nextL)!==JSON.stringify(layout)){
      if(sequence.enabled&&!fromSequence&&(JSON.stringify({...settings,brightness:nextS.brightness})!==JSON.stringify(nextS)||JSON.stringify(nextL)!==JSON.stringify(layout))){sequence.enabled=false;sequence.armed=false;note='Cue sequence stopped by a manual pattern or room edit.';}
      freezeForEdit();settings=nextS;layout=nextL;persistPrefs();
      if(mode==='live'&&!layout.selected.length){pause('No lamps selected. Live updates paused.');}
    }
  }
  function observe(data,finished,started=finished){
    const found=new Set();lastObservedAt=finished;readRevision++;
    for(const l of data){if(!byId.has(l.id))continue;found.add(l.id);const old=byId.get(l.id);byId.set(l.id,{...l,label:old.label,deviceLabel:old.deviceLabel,model:old.model});
      if(l.mode==='streaming'){held[l.id]='Streaming owner detected';offChecks[l.id]=0;continue;}
      if(mode==='live'&&settings.ownership==='yield_off'&&activated[l.id]&&started>(lastOwn[l.id]?.onAt||0)+500){
        if(l.on?.on===false){offChecks[l.id]=(offChecks[l.id]||0)+1;held[l.id]=offChecks[l.id]>=2?'Yielded to external off':'Checking an off readback';
          if(offChecks[l.id]===2)log('ownership','Yielded to two off readbacks; Start explicitly reclaims this lamp.',l.id);}
        else if(offChecks[l.id]===1&&l.on?.on===true){delete held[l.id];offChecks[l.id]=0;}
      }
      const d=session.delegated[l.id];if(d&&started>d.acceptedAt){const matches=d.kind==='effect'?((l.effects_v2?.status?.effect||l.effects?.status)===d.effect):l.dynamics?.status==='dynamic_palette';
        if(matches){d.confirmedAt=finished;d.state='reported';}
        else if(finished-d.acceptedAt>15000){d.state='not reported';}}
    }
    for(const l of lights)if(!found.has(l.id))held[l.id]='Missing from latest Bridge response';
  }
  const telemetry=makeTelemetryMonitor(cfg,lights,api,now,observe);
  function scanHueLayouts(){
    if(closed||layoutJob)return;layoutAttempted=true;layoutRead.pending=true;layoutRead.error='';layoutRead.revision++;
    layoutJob=fetchHueLayoutCatalog(cfg,lights,api,now,()=>closed).then(catalog=>{
      if(closed)return;layoutCatalog=catalog;layoutRead.fetchedAt=now();layoutRead.revision++;
    }).catch(e=>{if(!closed){layoutRead.error=shortError(e);layoutRead.revision++;}})
      .finally(()=>{layoutRead.pending=false;layoutJob=null;});
  }
  function importSavedHueLayout(payload,token){
    check(token);const candidate=layoutCatalog.find(a=>a.id===payload?.areaId);
    if(layoutRead.error||layoutRead.pending)throw new HueError('layout','Finish a successful Hue layout read before importing.');
    if(!candidate?.matched)throw new HueError('layout','Choose a saved Hue area with unambiguous matches in this room.');
    const next=applyHueLayout(layout,lights,candidate,payload,now());
    layoutUndo={layout:clone(layout),topology:settings.topology};
    const topology=next.hue.phaseMode==='keep'?settings.topology:next.hue.phaseMode==='clockwise'?'ring':'path';
    update({settings:{...settings,topology},layout:next});persistPrefs(true);
    note='Imported '+candidate.matched+'/'+candidate.total+' saved Hue placements. Unmatched lamps, selection, roles and brightness limits were preserved. No Hue layout or light writes were sent.';
    if(Object.keys(session.delegated).length)note+=' Existing Bridge playback continues.';
    mode=Object.keys(session.delegated).length?'detached':'paused';log('layout','Saved Hue placement imported locally.');
  }

  function pause(message='Updates paused. A request or fade already sent may still finish.') {
    sequence.enabled=false;sequence.armed=false;epoch++;pending=null;mode=Object.keys(session.delegated).length?'detached':'paused';note=message;log('control',message);
  }
  function active({includeHeld=false}={}){return layout.order.filter(id=>byId.get(id)?.dimming&&layout.selected.includes(id)&&(includeHeld||!held[id])&&byId.get(id)?.mode!=='streaming').map(id=>byId.get(id));}
  function launch(task){if(job||closed)return;jobStarted=now();quarantined=false;job=Promise.resolve().then(task).catch(e=>{
      if(errorKind(e)==='cancelled')return;
      controlError=shortError(e);log(errorKind(e),controlError);if(errorKind(e)==='auth'){epoch++;pending=null;mode='error';note='Authorization failed. No automatic re-pairing or retries.';}
    }).finally(()=>{job=null;jobStarted=0;quarantined=false;});}
  async function paced(token){check(token);while(now()-lastSend<350){await (options.sleep||sleep)(Math.max(1,350-(now()-lastSend)));check(token);}lastSend=now();}
  async function capture(ids,token,fresh=null){check(token);const missing=ids.filter(id=>!session.states[id]);if(!missing.length)return;
    const reply=fresh||await api(cfg,'GET','light');check(token);if(!Array.isArray(reply.data))throw new HueError('protocol','Invalid snapshot response.');
    for(const id of missing){const l=reply.data.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!l)throw new HueError('missing','A selected light is missing. Reopen the deck.');if(l.mode==='streaming')throw new HueError('ownership','A selected light belongs to an Entertainment stream. Stop it in its owning app first.');
      const base=byId.get(id);byId.set(id,{...l,label:base.label,deviceLabel:base.deviceLabel,model:base.model});
      session.states[id]={action:snapshotAction(l),capturedAt:now(),touchedAt:null,priorEffect:l.effects_v2?.status?.effect||l.effects?.status||null,priorDynamics:l.dynamics?.status||null};}
    persist();
  }
  async function write(id,action,kind,token){check(token);if(!session.states[id])throw new HueError('session','Restore state was not captured.');
    const light=byId.get(id);if(light?.mode==='streaming')throw new HueError('ownership','Entertainment owns this fixture. No REST write was sent.');
    await paced(token);check(token);
    session.states[id].touchedAt=session.states[id].touchedAt||now();persist();
    requested[id]={at:now(),kind,action:clone(action),status:'in flight'};
    const started=now();stats.currentWriters++;stats.maxConcurrentWriters=Math.max(stats.maxConcurrentWriters,stats.currentWriters);
    try{const reply=await api(cfg,'PUT','light/'+id,action);assertAck(reply,id);sent++;stats.writes++;
      telemetry.noteReply(id,action,kind,reply);requested[id].status='accepted';
      // Record the outcome even if Pause arrived while the request was already in flight.
      lastOwn[id]={acceptedAt:now(),onAt:action.on?.on===true?now():lastOwn[id]?.onAt||0,action:clone(action)};
      if(action.on?.on===true)activated[id]=true;
      if(kind==='live')networkFailures=0;
      return true;
    }catch(e){requested[id].status='uncertain / failed';requested[id].error=shortError(e);throw e;}
    finally{stats.currentWriters--;planner.complete(started,now());}
  }
  async function stopDelegated(token){
    const ids=Object.keys(session.delegated);if(!ids.length)return;
    const reply=await api(cfg,'GET','light');check(token);if(!Array.isArray(reply.data))throw new HueError('protocol','Cannot read state to stop Bridge effects.');
    for(const id of ids){check(token);const l=reply.data.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!l)throw new HueError('missing','A delegated light is missing; its restore point is retained.');
      byId.set(id,{...l,label:byId.get(id).label});const a=snapshotAction(l);delete a.on; // Do not turn a manually switched-off lamp back on.
      await write(id,a,'stop',token);delete session.delegated[id];persist();}
    note='Stop commands accepted. Readback shows whether the effect has stopped.';
  }
  function beginFromReadback(ids){const t=telemetry.snapshot();for(const id of ids){const row=t.data[id],l=byId.get(id);const p=layout.placements[id];
      // Baseline color conversion via telemetry's xy is approximate; frame interpolation starts at last intended frame if present.
      if(!fromFrames[id])fromFrames[id]=fixtureSample(elapsed,p,settings,0);
      const b=row?.brightness??l.dimming?.brightness;if(finite(b))fromFrames[id].b=row?.on===false?1:clamp(b,.1,100);}
    transitionAt=now();
  }
  async function startLive(token){check(token);if(recoveryRequired)throw new HueError('recovery','Choose Resume restore point or New baseline in Lab before starting.');
    const chosen=active({includeHeld:true});if(!chosen.length)throw new HueError('selection','Select a non-streaming dimmable light.');
    if(chosen.length>28)throw new HueError('validation','Select at most 28 dimmable lights for live animation. Everyday controls can manage larger areas.');
    await capture(chosen.map(l=>l.id),token);check(token);await stopDelegated(token);check(token);
    held={};offChecks={};failures={};activated={};badGradients.clear();networkFailures=0;controlError='';
    beginFromReadback(chosen.map(l=>l.id));planner.reset(chosen.map(l=>l.id),now());mode='live';lastTick=now();sequence.enabled=sequence.armed;sequence.armed=false;sequence.nextAt=activeSeconds+settings.sequenceHold;note='Live. External off yields control by default; only Start explicitly turns lamps on.';log('control','Live started');
  }
  async function nativePalette(token){
    if(!['room','zone'].includes(group.type))throw new HueError('validation','Choose a room or zone for a Bridge palette. The All lights view is local, not a Hue scene group.');
    if(recoveryRequired)throw new HueError('recovery','Resolve the saved restore point in Lab.');
    const chosen=active({includeHeld:true});if(!chosen.length)throw new HueError('selection','Select a light.');
    const animated=chosen.filter(l=>capabilities(l).color&&capabilities(l).dynamic&&!['task','anchor'].includes(layout.placements[l.id].role));
    if(!animated.length)throw new HueError('unsupported','No selected fixture advertises dynamic palettes. Try Bridge effects or Live.');
    await capture(chosen.map(l=>l.id),token);await stopDelegated(token);check(token);
    const s=clone(settings),layoutCopy=clone(layout);
    for(const lamp of animated){check(token);const current=byId.get(lamp.id),effect=current.effects_v2?.status?.effect||current.effects?.status;if(effect&&effect!=='no_effect'&&Object.keys(stopEffect(current)).length)await write(lamp.id,stopEffect(current),'handoff',token);}
    const actions=animated.map(l=>{const f=desired(l.id),a=actionFromFrame(l,f,layoutCopy.placements[l.id],s,0,true);delete a.dynamics;return {target:{rid:l.id,rtype:'light'},action:a};});
    // A shared native palette cannot preserve individual gain curves. Use the minimum
    // selected trim/ceiling as a conservative cap, and explain that limitation in UI.
    const level=Math.min(...animated.map(l=>Math.min(s.brightness*layoutCopy.placements[l.id].trim,layoutCopy.placements[l.id].ceiling,100)));
    const paletteIndex=s.morph<50?s.paletteA:s.paletteB;
    const payload={metadata:{name:'Hue Board | '+ENGINE.palettes[paletteIndex].name},actions,
      palette:{color:ENGINE.getColors(s,paletteIndex).map(c=>({color:{xy:ENGINE.xy(c)},dimming:{brightness:level}})),dimming:[],color_temperature:[],effects:[]},
      speed:+clamp(.15+s.speed*.35,.1,.8).toFixed(2),auto_dynamic:true};
    let id=sceneRegistry[area]?.id;
    if(id){try{const r=await api(cfg,'GET','scene/'+id);check(token);const actual=r.data?.find(x=>x.id===id);
        if(!actual||actual.group?.rid!==group.id||actual.group?.rtype!==group.type)throw new HueError('ownership','Saved scene identity/group mismatch. It was not modified.');
      }catch(e){if(e.status===404){id=null;delete sceneRegistry[area];save(V3_SCENES,sceneRegistry);}else throw e;}}
    await paced(token);
    if(id){const r=await api(cfg,'PUT','scene/'+id,payload);assertAck(r,id);}
    else {const r=await api(cfg,'POST','scene',{...payload,group:{rid:group.id,rtype:group.type}});id=r.data?.find(x=>x.rtype==='scene'||x.rid)?.rid;
      if(!id)throw new HueError('protocol','Scene creation result is uncertain. Inspect Hue scenes before retrying.');
      sceneRegistry[area]={id,group:group.id,type:group.type,createdAt:now()};save(V3_SCENES,sceneRegistry);}
    check(token);
    for(const l of animated){session.states[l.id].touchedAt=session.states[l.id].touchedAt||now();session.delegated[l.id]={kind:'palette',scene:id,acceptedAt:now(),state:'request pending'};}
    persist();await paced(token);check(token);const recall=await api(cfg,'PUT','scene/'+id,{recall:{action:'dynamic_palette'}});assertAck(recall,id);sent++;
    for(const l of animated){session.delegated[l.id].acceptedAt=now();session.delegated[l.id].state='accepted';telemetry.noteReply(l.id,null,'native',recall,id);}persist();
    for(const l of chosen.filter(l=>!animated.includes(l))){check(token);const p=layoutCopy.placements[l.id],f=fixtureSample(elapsed,{...p,role:p.role==='task'?'task':'anchor'},s);await write(l.id,{...actionFromFrame(l,f,p,s,2500,true),...stopEffect(l)},'static',token);}
    check(token);mode='delegated';note='Bridge palette accepted for '+animated.length+' lights. You may lock your phone; the Bridge continues independently. This is palette animation, not the exact Studio choreography.';
  }
  async function nativeEffect(token){
    if(recoveryRequired)throw new HueError('recovery','Resolve the saved restore point in Lab.');
    const chosen=active({includeHeld:true}),name=settings.effect,s=clone(settings),ls=clone(layout);
    const supported=chosen.filter(l=>capabilities(l).effects.includes(name)&&!['task','anchor'].includes(ls.placements[l.id].role));
    if(!supported.length)throw new HueError('unsupported','Select an advertised effect and at least one supported fixture.');
    await capture(chosen.map(l=>l.id),token);await stopDelegated(token);check(token);
    for(const l of supported){check(token);session.delegated[l.id]={kind:'effect',effect:name,acceptedAt:now(),state:'request pending'};persist();
      await write(l.id,effectAction(byId.get(l.id),name,s,ls.placements[l.id]),'effect',token);session.delegated[l.id].acceptedAt=now();session.delegated[l.id].state='accepted';persist();}
    for(const l of chosen.filter(l=>!supported.includes(l)&&['task','anchor'].includes(ls.placements[l.id].role))){check(token);const p=ls.placements[l.id];await write(l.id,{...actionFromFrame(l,fixtureSample(elapsed,p,s),p,s,2500,true),...stopEffect(l)},'static',token);}
    check(token);mode='delegated';note=name+' accepted for '+supported.length+'/'+chosen.length+' selected lamps. Unsupported accent/wash fixtures were left unchanged.';
  }
  async function restore(token){
    const errors=[];restoreFailures=[];
    for(const id of Object.keys(session.states)){check(token);const record=session.states[id];
      if(!record.touchedAt&&!session.legacy){delete session.states[id];continue;}
      try{await write(id,record.action,'restore',token);delete session.states[id];delete session.delegated[id];delete held[id];persist();}
      catch(e){if(errorKind(e)==='cancelled')throw e;errors.push(layout.order.indexOf(id)+1);restoreFailures.push({id,error:shortError(e)});log('restore',shortError(e),id);if(errorKind(e)==='auth'||errorKind(e)==='network')break;}
    }
    persist();check(token);mode='paused';recoveryRequired=false;note=errors.length?'Some restore commands failed. Remaining snapshots are retained; tap Restore to retry.':'Static restore commands accepted. Prior animations are not resumed.';
    if(errors.length)controlError=errors.length+' lamp restore command(s) failed.';
  }

  function refreshScenes(){
    if(closed||sceneJob)return;scenesPending=true;scenesError='';
    sceneJob=Promise.resolve().then(()=>api(cfg,'GET','scene')).then(r=>{
      if(closed)return;if(!Array.isArray(r?.data))throw new HueError('protocol','Invalid saved-scene response.');
      sceneList=r.data.filter(x=>typeof x.id==='string'&&(group.type==='all'||(x.group?.rid===group.id&&x.group?.rtype===group.type)))
        .map(x=>({id:x.id,name:String(x.metadata?.name||'Unnamed scene'),count:(x.actions||[]).filter(a=>byId.has(a.target?.rid)).length})).filter(x=>x.count>0);
      scenesReadAt=now();
    }).catch(e=>{if(!closed)scenesError=shortError(e);}).finally(()=>{scenesPending=false;sceneJob=null;});
  }
  async function manual(token,intent){
    check(token);
    if(recoveryRequired&&intent.on!==false)throw new HueError('recovery','Review the saved restore point above before changing lights. Off remains available.');
    const reply=await api(cfg,'GET','light');check(token);
    if(!Array.isArray(reply.data))throw new HueError('protocol','Cannot read current lights. Nothing was sent.');
