    const fresh=new Map(reply.data.map(l=>[l.id,l])),actions=[];
    manualResult={at:now(),total:intent.ids.length,accepted:[],skipped:[],failed:[]};
    for(const id of intent.ids){const l=fresh.get(id),old=byId.get(id);
      if(!l){manualResult.skipped.push({id,reason:'Missing from current Bridge response'});continue;}
      byId.set(id,{...l,label:old.label,deviceLabel:old.deviceLabel,model:old.model});
      if(l.mode==='streaming'){manualResult.skipped.push({id,reason:'Owned by an Entertainment stream'});continue;}
      try{const action=manualAction(l,layout.placements[id],intent);if(action)actions.push({id,action});else manualResult.skipped.push({id,reason:'This control is not supported'});}
      catch(e){manualResult.skipped.push({id,reason:shortError(e)});}
    }
    if(!actions.length)throw new HueError('unsupported','No addressed light supports this action. Streaming lights are never overridden.');
    await capture(actions.map(a=>a.id),token,reply);check(token);
    for(const {id,action} of actions){check(token);
      try{await write(id,action,'manual',token);manualResult.accepted.push(id);delete session.delegated[id];delete held[id];persist();}
      catch(e){if(errorKind(e)==='cancelled')throw e;manualResult.failed.push({id,reason:shortError(e)});if(['auth','network','rate','server'].includes(errorKind(e)))break;}
    }
    check(token);mode=Object.keys(session.delegated).length?'detached':'manual';
    const unfinished=manualResult.total-manualResult.accepted.length-manualResult.skipped.length-manualResult.failed.length;
    note=manualResult.accepted.length+' / '+manualResult.total+' light command(s) accepted.'+(manualResult.skipped.length?' '+manualResult.skipped.length+' unsupported, missing or streaming.':'')+(unfinished?' Remaining commands were not sent.':'')+' Readback will confirm reported state.';
    if(manualResult.failed.length)controlError='Some light commands failed. Check the affected lights before retrying.';
    log('manual',note);persist();
  }
  async function applySavedScene(token,id){
    if(recoveryRequired)throw new HueError('recovery','Review the saved restore point before applying a scene.');
    if(typeof id!=='string'||!sceneList.some(x=>x.id===id))throw new HueError('selection','Refresh and choose one of this area’s saved Hue scenes.');
    const result=await api(cfg,'GET','scene/'+id);check(token);
    const scene=result.data?.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!scene||(group.type!=='all'&&(scene.group?.rid!==group.id||scene.group?.rtype!==group.type)))throw new HueError('ownership','Scene group changed. Refresh the list.');
    const response=await api(cfg,'GET','light');check(token);if(!Array.isArray(response.data))throw new HueError('protocol','Cannot inspect scene targets.');
    const current=new Map(response.data.map(l=>[l.id,l])),actions=[];
    for(const entry of scene.actions||[]){const lid=entry.target?.rid,light=current.get(lid),p=layout.placements[lid];
      if(entry.target?.rtype!=='light'||!p||!light||light.mode==='streaming'||actions.some(a=>a.id===lid))continue;
      const raw=entry.action||{};
      // A static copy only. No arbitrary scene effects, recalls or destructive operations.
      const action=validatedSnapshot({...raw,on:raw.on||light.on},light);if(!action)continue;
      if(action.dimming){const minimum=Math.max(.1,light.dimming?.min_dim_level||.1);if(p.ceiling<minimum)continue;action.dimming.brightness=+clamp(action.dimming.brightness*p.trim,minimum,p.ceiling).toFixed(2);}
      const previous=byId.get(lid);byId.set(lid,{...light,label:previous.label,deviceLabel:previous.deviceLabel,model:previous.model});actions.push({id:lid,action});
    }
    if(!actions.length)throw new HueError('unsupported','No compatible static scene actions in this area.');
    await capture(actions.map(a=>a.id),token,response);
    manualResult={at:now(),total:actions.length,accepted:[],skipped:[],failed:[]};
    for(const a of actions){check(token);try{await write(a.id,a.action,'scene-copy',token);manualResult.accepted.push(a.id);delete session.delegated[a.id];persist();}catch(e){if(errorKind(e)!=='cancelled')manualResult.failed.push({id:a.id,reason:shortError(e)});throw e;}}
    check(token);mode=Object.keys(session.delegated).length?'detached':'manual';note='Applied a static copy of '+String(scene.metadata?.name||'the scene')+'. Your fixture limits were retained; the saved Hue scene was not modified.';
  }
  function newSession(){if(job||Object.keys(session.delegated).length)throw new HueError('state','Pause and stop Bridge effects before starting a new baseline.');
    journal.history.push({area,archivedAt:now(),session:clone(session)});journal.history=journal.history.slice(-6);
    session={id:newId(),bridgeId:cfg.bridgeId||cfg.ip,group:group.id,groupType:group.type,createdAt:now(),states:{},delegated:{},legacy:false};
    recoveryRequired=false;activated={};held={};fromFrames={};fromGradient={};persist();note='New session. Fresh states will be captured on the next Start or Bridge handoff.';
  }
  function dispatch(command,payload=null){if(closed)return;
    if(command==='background'||command==='backgroundPreset'){
      if(command==='backgroundPreset'&&!PRESET_LIBRARY.some(p=>p.id===payload)){controlError='Choose a valid scene from the library.';return;}
      const eligible=layout.order.filter(id=>layout.selected.includes(id)&&byId.get(id)?.mode!=='streaming'&&capabilities(byId.get(id)).color&&capabilities(byId.get(id)).dynamic&&!['task','anchor'].includes(layout.placements[id].role));
      if(!['room','zone'].includes(group.type)){controlError='Choose a Hue room or zone. All lights is a local view and cannot host a Bridge scene.';return;}
      if(!eligible.length){controlError='No selected color lights support a Bridge dynamic palette. Choose another area or try an advertised Bridge effect in Studio.';return;}
    }
    if(command==='refreshScenes'){refreshScenes();return;}
    if(command==='manual'){let intent;try{intent=validateManualIntent(payload,byId);}catch(e){controlError=shortError(e);return;}
      pause('Applying everyday lighting. Live animation is paused.');pending={command,token:epoch,payload:intent};controlError='';mode='adjusting';return;}
    if(command==='applyScene'){pause('Applying a static copy of the saved Hue scene.');pending={command,token:epoch,payload};controlError='';mode='adjusting';return;}
    if(command==='playPreset'||command==='backgroundPreset'){try{update({settings:applyLibraryPreset(settings,payload)});command=command==='backgroundPreset'?'background':'live';}catch(e){controlError=shortError(e);return;}}
    if(command==='applyPreset'){try{update({settings:applyLibraryPreset(settings,payload)});note='Preset applied without starting playback. Master brightness and room limits retained.';}catch(e){controlError=shortError(e);}return;}
    if(command==='stopSequence'){sequence.enabled=false;sequence.armed=false;note='Cue sequence stopped; the current live look continues.';return;}
    if(command==='startSequence'){
      const ids=settings.sequenceIds.filter(id=>PRESET_LIBRARY.some(p=>p.id===id));
      if(!ids.length){controlError='Add at least one valid preset to the cue sequence.';return;}
      update({settings:applyLibraryPreset({...settings,sequenceIds:ids},ids[0])},true);
      sequence={enabled:false,armed:true,index:0,cycle:0,nextAt:0};command='live';
    } else if(['live','bridge','background','restore','stopBridge'].includes(command)){sequence.enabled=false;sequence.armed=false;}

    if(command==='refreshHueLayout'){scanHueLayouts();return;}
    if(command==='importHueLayout'){
      if(layoutRead.error||layoutRead.pending){controlError='Finish a successful Hue layout read before importing.';return;}
      if(!layoutCatalog.some(a=>a.id===payload?.areaId&&a.matched)){controlError='Choose a Hue area with matching saved coordinates.';return;}
      pause('Pausing live updates before applying saved Hue positions. An in-flight request may still finish.');
      pending={command:'importHueLayout',payload:clone(payload),token:epoch};controlError='';return;
    }
    if(command==='undoHueLayout'){
      if(!layoutUndo){controlError='No layout import to undo.';return;}
      pause('Restoring the local layout from before the last Hue import.');pending={command:'undoHueLayout',token:epoch};controlError='';return;
    }
    if(command==='pause'){pause();return;}
    if(command==='resumeSession'){recoveryRequired=false;note='Saved restore point retained. Start continues that session.';return;}
    if(command==='newSession'){pause();try{newSession();}catch(e){controlError=shortError(e);}return;}
    if(command==='surge'){if(mode==='live'){surgeAt=now();note='12-second bounded lift; master and fixture caps still apply.';}return;}
    if(command==='clearYield'){held={};offChecks={};note='Yield flags cleared. Start is still required to turn an off lamp back on.';return;}
    if(command==='savePreset'||command==='saveRoom'){
      const name=String(payload||'').trim().slice(0,48);if(!name)return;const list=command==='savePreset'?presets:rooms,item=command==='savePreset'?{schema:3,name,settings:clone(settings)}:{schema:3,name,layout:clone(layout)};
      const i=list.findIndex(v=>v.name===name);if(i>=0)list[i]=item;else list.push(item);if(list.length>20)list.shift();persistPrefs(true);note='Saved '+name;return;}
    if(command==='loadPreset'||command==='loadRoom'){
      const list=command==='loadPreset'?presets:rooms,item=list.find(v=>v.name===payload);if(!item)return;update({settings:command==='loadPreset'?item.settings:settings,layout:command==='loadRoom'?item.layout:layout});note='Loaded '+item.name+'. No new show was started.';return;}
    if(command==='restoreArchive'){
      if(job||Object.keys(session.delegated).length){controlError='Pause and stop Bridge effects before recovering an archived baseline.';return;}
      const entry=journal.history.filter(v=>v.area===area).find(v=>v.session.id===payload);if(!entry)return;
      pause();const current=clone(session);session=clone(entry.session);session.delegated=session.delegated||{};for(const id of Object.keys(session.states||{})){const light=byId.get(id),action=light&&validatedSnapshot(session.states[id]?.action,light);if(action)session.states[id].action=action;else delete session.states[id];}for(const id of Object.keys(session.delegated))if(!byId.has(id))delete session.delegated[id];journal.history.push({area,archivedAt:now(),session:current});journal.history=journal.history.slice(-6);recoveryRequired=true;persist();note='Archived restore point selected. Review its timestamp before Restore.';return;
    }
    if(!['live','bridge','background','restore','stopBridge'].includes(command))return;
    epoch++;pending={command,token:epoch};controlError='';mode=command==='restore'?'restoring':command==='stopBridge'?'stopping':'preparing';
    note=job?'Waiting for the already-started request; no further old work will be launched.':'Preparing '+command+'.';
  }
  function launchPending(){if(!pending||job)return;const task=pending;pending=null;launch(async()=>{
      try {check(task.token);if(task.command==='importHueLayout'){importSavedHueLayout(task.payload,task.token);}
      else if(task.command==='undoHueLayout'){const previous=layoutUndo;layoutUndo=null;update({settings:{...settings,topology:previous.topology},layout:previous.layout});persistPrefs(true);note='Previous local layout restored. No light or Hue layout writes sent.';}
      else if(task.command==='manual')await manual(task.token,task.payload);else if(task.command==='applyScene')await applySavedScene(task.token,task.payload);
      else if(task.command==='live')await startLive(task.token);else if(task.command==='background')await nativePalette(task.token);else if(task.command==='bridge')await (settings.nativeKind==='effect'?nativeEffect(task.token):nativePalette(task.token));else if(task.command==='restore')await restore(task.token);else{await stopDelegated(task.token);check(task.token);mode='paused';}}
      catch(e){if(errorKind(e)==='cancelled')return;if(isCurrent(task.token)){mode=Object.keys(session.delegated).length?'detached':'error';note='Action stopped. Restore points and partial handoffs are retained.';}throw e;}
    });}
  function launchFrame(){
    const time=now(),candidates=active().filter(l=>!failures[l.id]||time>=failures[l.id].retryAt);
    const plan=planner.plan(candidates.map(l=>l.id),time);if(!plan)return;
    if(plan.overloaded){pause('Request latency is too high for coherent live fades. Use Bridge playback or a smaller area.');return;}
    const token=epoch,l=byId.get(plan.id),p=layout.placements[l.id];planner.start(l.id,time,plan.cycle);if(plan.lateness>350)stats.missedDeadlines++;
    launch(async()=>{
      try{check(token);if(!session.states[l.id])await capture([l.id],token);check(token);
        const at=now()+plan.horizon,targetT=elapsed+plan.horizon/1000*settings.speed;
        const f=desired(l.id,targetT,at),g=gradients(l.id,targetT,at);
        let action=actionFromFrame(byId.get(l.id),f,p,settings,plan.horizon,!activated[l.id]||settings.ownership==='hold',g);
        if(!activated[l.id])action={...action,...stopEffect(byId.get(l.id))};
        try{await write(l.id,action,'live',token);}catch(e){
          if(action.gradient&&errorKind(e)==='api'&&/gradient|points|palette/i.test(e.message)){badGradients.add(l.id);log('capability','Gradient rejected; using whole-light color.',l.id);check(token);
            action=actionFromFrame(byId.get(l.id),f,p,settings,plan.horizon,!activated[l.id]);await write(l.id,action,'live',token);}
          else throw e;}
        delete failures[l.id];
      }catch(e){if(errorKind(e)==='cancelled')return;const n=(failures[l.id]?.count||0)+1;totalFailures++;const retryAt=now()+Math.min(60000,2000*2**Math.min(n-1,5));
        failures[l.id]={count:n,retryAt,error:shortError(e),kind:errorKind(e)};log(errorKind(e),shortError(e),l.id);
        if(errorKind(e)==='auth'){pause('Authorization rejected. Fix pairing from the main menu.');mode='error';controlError=shortError(e);}
        else if(['network','server','rate'].includes(errorKind(e))){networkFailures++;if(networkFailures>=3){pause('Bridge connection failed repeatedly. Start retries after you resolve it.');mode='error';controlError=shortError(e);}}
        else if(['api','unsupported','missing','ownership'].includes(errorKind(e))){held[l.id]=shortError(e);}
      }
    });
  }
  function tick(hidden=false){if(closed)return;
    const stamp=now(),dt=stamp-lastTick;lastTick=stamp;
    if(hidden||dt<0||dt>8000){if(['live','preparing','adjusting'].includes(mode))pause('Paused after app suspension or a clock interruption. Tap Start to resume.');}
    else if(mode==='live'){
      elapsed+=dt/1000*settings.speed;activeSeconds+=dt/1000;
      if(sequence.enabled&&activeSeconds>=sequence.nextAt){
        const ids=settings.sequenceIds.filter(id=>PRESET_LIBRARY.some(p=>p.id===id));
        if(!ids.length)sequence.enabled=false;
        else {sequence.cycle++;const old=sequence.index;
          sequence.index=settings.sequenceOrder==='shuffle'?Math.floor(ENGINE.hash(settings.seed,sequence.cycle+9000)*ids.length):(old+1)%ids.length;
          if(ids.length>1&&sequence.index===old)sequence.index=(old+1)%ids.length;
          update({settings:applyLibraryPreset(settings,ids[sequence.index])},true);sequence.nextAt=activeSeconds+settings.sequenceHold;
          note='Cue '+(sequence.index+1)+' / '+ids.length+': '+PRESET_LIBRARY.find(p=>p.id===ids[sequence.index]).name;
        }
      }
    }
    if(!hidden){telemetry.tick();if(!layoutAttempted&&options.autoDiscover!==false)scanHueLayouts();}
    if(job&&stamp-jobStarted>12000&&!quarantined){quarantined=true;epoch++;pending=null;mode='error';controlError='A request has not settled. Writer quarantined; no overlapping retries will be sent.';note='Close only after the request settles, or stop the script. An in-flight request cannot be recalled.';log('timeout',controlError);}
    if(!job&&!hidden){if(pending)launchPending();else if(mode==='live')launchFrame();}
    persistPrefs();
  }
  function state(){const telem=telemetry.snapshot(),design={};for(const l of lights)design[l.id]=desired(l.id);
    const effective={};for(const id of layout.order)effective[id]=held[id]||session.delegated[id]?.state||(mode==='live'&&layout.selected.includes(id)?'live':'uncontrolled');
    const backgroundEligible=['room','zone'].includes(group.type)?layout.selected.filter(id=>{const l=byId.get(id);return l&&l.mode!=='streaming'&&capabilities(l).color&&capabilities(l).dynamic&&!['task','anchor'].includes(layout.placements[id].role);}).length:0;
    return {version:VERSION,background:{available:backgroundEligible>0,count:backgroundEligible,groupType:group.type},ui:clone(ui),sequence:{...sequence,remaining:Math.max(0,sequence.nextAt-activeSeconds)},systemDark:typeof Device!=='undefined'&&typeof Device.isUsingDarkAppearance==='function'?Device.isUsingDarkAppearance():null,mode,running:mode==='live',native:Object.keys(session.delegated).length>0,busy:!!job||!!pending,inFlight:!!job,quarantined,
      sent,t:elapsed,note,error:controlError,settings:clone(settings),layout:clone(layout),design,surge:surge(),telemetry:clone(telem),
      touched:Object.values(session.states).filter(v=>v.touchedAt||session.legacy).length,
      session:{id:session.id,createdAt:session.createdAt,legacy:session.legacy,recoveryRequired,entries:Object.entries(session.states).map(([id,v])=>({id,capturedAt:v.capturedAt,touchedAt:v.touchedAt})),archives:journal.history.filter(v=>v.area===area).map(v=>({id:v.session.id,createdAt:v.session.createdAt,archivedAt:v.archivedAt}))},
      ownership:effective,failures:clone(failures),requested:clone(requested),delegated:clone(session.delegated),restoreFailures:clone(restoreFailures),
      hueLayouts:{...layoutRead,canUndo:!!layoutUndo,areas:layoutCatalog.map(a=>({id:a.id,name:a.name,type:a.type,active:a.active,matched:a.matched,total:a.total,outside:a.outside,fetchedAt:a.fetchedAt,
        warnings:a.warnings,unmatched:a.unmatched,matchedNames:a.records.map(r=>byId.get(r.lightId)?.label||'Lamp')}))},
      manualResult:clone(manualResult),savedScenes:{items:clone(sceneList),pending:scenesPending,error:scenesError,readAt:scenesReadAt},
      effects:availableEffects([...byId.values()],layout),capabilities:Object.fromEntries([...byId].map(([id,l])=>[id,capabilities(l)])),
      effectParams:Object.fromEntries([...byId].map(([id,l])=>[id,{effect:l.effects_v2?.status?.effect,speed:finite(l.effects_v2?.status?.parameters?.speed),color:!!l.effects_v2?.status?.parameters?.color}])),
      stats:{...stats,latencyMs:Math.round(planner.latency),horizonMs:Math.round(planner.horizon),failures:totalFailures},
      logs:clone(logs),presets:clone(presets),rooms:clone(rooms),clock:now(),lastObservedAt};}
  function diagnostics(){const s=state();return {app:'hue-board',version:VERSION,exportedAt:new Date(now()).toISOString(),mode:s.mode,
    stats:s.stats,session:{createdAt:s.session.createdAt,legacy:s.session.legacy,entries:s.session.entries.length},
    lamps:layout.order.map((id,i)=>({number:i+1,capabilities:s.capabilities[id],ownership:s.ownership[id],failure:s.failures[id]?{count:s.failures[id].count,kind:s.failures[id].kind}:null,readAge:TELEMETRY.age(s.telemetry.data[id]?.fetchedAt,now())})),
    // Names, resource IDs, IPs, keys, payloads and raw network errors deliberately excluded.
    events:logs.map(v=>({at:v.at,kind:v.kind,lamp:v.lamp}))};}
  async function close(){closed=true;epoch++;pending=null;mode='paused';telemetry.stop();persistPrefs(true);persist();if(job)await job;persist();}
  function recovery(choice){if(choice==='resume'){recoveryRequired=false;note='Saved session retained.';}else if(choice==='new')newSession();}
  return {tick,dispatch,update,state,diagnostics,close,recovery,area,meta:{name:group.name,lights:lights.map(l=>({id:l.id,name:l.label,device:l.deviceLabel||'',capabilities:capabilities(l)}))},
    settled:async()=>{if(job)await job;},scenesSettled:async()=>{if(sceneJob)await sceneJob;},layoutSettled:async()=>{if(layoutJob)await layoutJob;},_observe:observe,_planner:planner,_session:()=>clone(session)};
}


// ===== workspace =====
/** One active writer across area switches. Physical limits are shared across overlapping rooms/zones. */
function makeWorkspaceController(cfg, groups, initialGroup, options={}) {
  const read=options.read||readObject,save=options.save||writeObject;
  const factory=options.factory||((g)=>makeController(cfg,g,options));
  const limitKey=FIXTURE_LIMITS_STORE,bridge=cfg.bridgeId||cfg.ip;
  const limits=read(limitKey,{});limits[bridge]=limits[bridge]||{};
  // Conservative one-time migration. Never silently lifts an old ceiling or resets a trim.
  for(const [key,value]of Object.entries(read(V3_STORE,{}))){if(!key.startsWith(bridge+'/'))continue;
    for(const [id,p]of Object.entries(value?.layout?.placements||{})){
      if(!finite(p.ceiling)||!finite(p.trim))continue;
      const existing=limits[bridge][id];if(!existing)limits[bridge][id]={ceiling:clamp(p.ceiling,5,100),trim:clamp(p.trim,.1,1),migrated:true};
      else if(existing.migrated===true){existing.ceiling=Math.min(existing.ceiling,clamp(p.ceiling,5,100));existing.trim=Math.min(existing.trim,clamp(p.trim,.1,1));}
    }
  }
  // Seal migration: future old versions must not silently re-lower an explicitly changed limit.
  for(const p of Object.values(limits[bridge]))delete p.migrated;
  save(limitKey,limits);
  const key=g=>g.type+'/'+g.id;
  let group=initialGroup,ctl,closed=false,switchJob=null,switchError='';
  function create(g){const next=factory(g),s=next.state(),layout=clone(s.layout);
    for(const id of layout.order){const limit=limits[bridge][id];if(limit)Object.assign(layout.placements[id],limit);else limits[bridge][id]={ceiling:layout.placements[id].ceiling,trim:layout.placements[id].trim};}
    next.update({layout});save(limitKey,limits);return next;}
  ctl=create(group);
  function state(){return {...ctl.state(),meta:{...ctl.meta,scopeId:key(group),type:group.type},navigation:{current:key(group),switching:!!switchJob,error:switchError,areas:groups.map(g=>({id:key(g),name:g.name,type:g.type,count:g.lights.length}))}};}
  function update(packet){if(closed||switchJob)return;
    const before=ctl.state().layout;ctl.update(packet);const after=ctl.state().layout;
    let changed=false;for(const id of after.order){const p=after.placements[id],b=before.placements[id];if(!b||p.ceiling!==b.ceiling||p.trim!==b.trim){limits[bridge][id]={ceiling:p.ceiling,trim:p.trim};changed=true;}}
    if(changed)save(limitKey,limits);
  }
  function dispatch(name,payload){if(closed)return;
    if(name!=='switchArea'){if(!switchJob)ctl.dispatch(name,payload);else if(name==='pause')ctl.dispatch(name);return;}
    if(switchJob)return;
    const next=groups.find(g=>key(g)===payload);if(!next){switchError='That area is no longer available. Refresh inventory from the main menu.';return;}
    if(next===group)return;switchError='';const old=group;
    ctl.dispatch('pause');
    switchJob=(async()=>{await ctl.close();if(closed)return;
      try{const replacement=create(next);ctl=replacement;group=next;cfg.group={rid:group.id,rtype:group.type};if(options.saveConfig)options.saveConfig(cfg);else saveConfig(cfg);}
      catch(e){switchError=shortError(e);if(!closed){ctl=create(old);group=old;}}
    })().finally(()=>{switchJob=null;});
  }
  return {get meta(){return {...ctl.meta,scopeId:key(group),type:group.type};},state,update,dispatch,
    tick(hidden){if(!closed&&!switchJob)ctl.tick(hidden);},diagnostics:()=>ctl.diagnostics(),
    async close(){closed=true;if(switchJob)await switchJob;await ctl.close();},
    async settled(){if(switchJob)await switchJob;await ctl.settled();},_controller:()=>ctl};
}


// ===== ui-react =====
/** Fully bundled React WebView. No credentials, fetches, external styles, or runtime package loader. */
function buildPage(meta,initial) {
  const safeScript=source=>source.replace(/<\/script/gi,'<\\/script');
  const globals='window.HUE_BOARD_ENGINE='+makeEngine.toString()+';window.HUE_BOARD_TELEMETRY='+makeTelemetryTools.toString()+';window.HUE_BOARD_LAYOUT={project:'+hueProjection.toString()+',text:'+huePlacementText.toString()+'};window.HUE_BOARD_PRESETS='+safeJSON(PRESET_LIBRARY)+';window.HUE_BOARD_META='+safeJSON(meta)+';window.HUE_BOARD_INITIAL='+safeJSON(initial)+';';
  return `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark"><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'"><title>Hue Board</title><style>${FRONTEND_CSS}</style></head><body><div id="boot" class="boot" role="status"><strong>Opening Hue Board</strong><p id="bootDetail">Preparing the interface. No lighting commands have been sent.</p></div><div id="root"></div><script>
window.DECK_BOOT={ready:false,error:''};window.deckBootError=function(message){window.DECK_BOOT.error=String(message);var box=document.getElementById('boot');box.hidden=false;box.classList.add('error');document.getElementById('bootDetail').textContent=String(message)+' Close with Done and use Compatibility controls. Your pairing is unchanged.';};window.addEventListener('error',function(e){window.deckBootError(e.message||'Interface error');});window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',function(e){window.deckBootError(String(e.reason||'Interface promise error'));});setTimeout(function(){if(!window.DECK_BOOT.ready)window.deckBootError('Interface startup did not complete.');},6500);
${safeScript(globals)}
(function(){var mode=window.HUE_BOARD_INITIAL.ui&&window.HUE_BOARD_INITIAL.ui.theme||'system';var dark=typeof window.HUE_BOARD_INITIAL.systemDark==='boolean'?window.HUE_BOARD_INITIAL.systemDark:matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;var theme=mode==='system'?(dark?'dark':'light'):mode;document.documentElement.dataset.theme=theme;document.documentElement.style.colorScheme=theme;})();
${safeScript(REACT_RUNTIME)}
${safeScript(FRONTEND_JS)}
</script></body></html>`;
}


// ===== ui-native =====
/** First-class native fallback. Direct selection pages, not repetitive cycling. */
function makeCompatibilityPanel(meta,initial) {
  const table=new UITable();table.showSeparators=true;
  let s=clone(initial.settings),l=clone(initial.layout),state=initial,dirty=false,command=null,view='lights',picker=null,lastRender='',hueProjectionChoice=initial.layout.hue?.projection||'xy',huePhaseChoice=initial.layout.hue?.phaseMode||'clockwise';
  const lamp=id=>meta.lights.find(v=>v.id===id);
  const colors={ink:()=>Color.dynamic(new Color('#15202b'),new Color('#e7f1f7')),muted:()=>Color.dynamic(new Color('#596b7b'),new Color('#9db1c0')),cyan:()=>Color.dynamic(new Color('#00738a'),new Color('#69dcee')),lime:()=>Color.dynamic(new Color('#3e6400'),new Color('#c9f58b'))};
  function send(name,payload=null){const urgent=['pause','restore','stopBridge','stopSequence'];if(command&&urgent.includes(command.name)&&!urgent.includes(name))return;command={name,payload};render(true);}
  function changed(){dirty=true;render(true);}
  function text(title,subtitle='',height=70){const row=new UITableRow();row.height=Math.max(height,55+Math.ceil(title.length/40)*13+Math.ceil(subtitle.length/55)*13);row.dismissOnSelect=false;const c=row.addText(title,subtitle);c.titleColor=colors.ink();c.subtitleColor=colors.muted();table.addRow(row);return row;}
  function button(row,title,fn,enabled=true){const c=row.addButton(enabled?title:title+' · unavailable');c.dismissOnTap=false;c.titleColor=enabled?colors.cyan():colors.muted();c.widthWeight=1;c.onTap=()=>{if(enabled)fn();};return c;}
  function buttons(items,height=60){const row=new UITableRow();row.height=height;row.dismissOnSelect=false;for(const item of items)button(row,...item);table.addRow(row);}
  function pick(title,items,handler){picker={title,items,handler};render(true);}
  function field(key,title,items){const value=s[key],row=text(title,items.find(x=>x[0]===value)?.[1]||String(value));row.onSelect=()=>pick(title,items,v=>{s[key]=v;changed();});}
  function range(key,label,min,max,step,unit){const row=new UITableRow();row.height=60;const c=row.addText(label+' '+(step<1?s[key].toFixed(2):Math.round(s[key]))+unit);c.widthWeight=3;c.titleColor=colors.ink();for(const [text,dir]of[['−',-1],['+',1]])button(row,text,()=>{s[key]=+clamp(s[key]+dir*step,min,max).toFixed(2);changed();},s[key]+dir*step>=min&&s[key]+dir*step<=max);table.addRow(row);}
  function importHueChoice(){const areas=(state.hueLayouts?.areas||[]).filter(a=>a.matched);
    pick('Saved Hue Entertainment areas',areas.map(a=>[a.id,a.name+' · '+a.matched+'/'+a.total+' lamps']),async id=>{const a=areas.find(v=>v.id===id);if(!a)return;
      const detail='Import '+a.matched+'/'+a.total+' placements? '+(a.unmatched.length?'Unchanged: '+a.unmatched.map(v=>v.name).join(', ')+'. ':'')+a.warnings.join(' ')+' Live pauses; no Hue layout/light writes. The old local layout is saved for Undo.';
      if(await confirm(a.name,detail))send('importHueLayout',{areaId:id,projection:hueProjectionChoice,phaseMode:huePhaseChoice});});}
  function promptName(commandName){input('Save '+(commandName==='saveRoom'?'room layout':'mix'),'Choose a short name.').then(name=>{if(name)send(commandName,name);}).catch(()=>{});}
  function render(force=false){const sig=JSON.stringify({s,l,view,picker:picker?.title,mode:state.mode,busy:state.busy,error:state.error,note:state.note,session:state.session,hue:state.hueLayouts,telemetry:state.telemetry?.revision,ages:Math.floor(Date.now()/5000),command});
    if(!force&&sig===lastRender)return;lastRender=sig;table.removeAllRows();
    text('Hue Board',meta.name+' · '+(state.mode||'ready'),65);
    if(picker){const current=picker;buttons([['Back',()=>{picker=null;render(true);}]]);text(current.title,'Select an option directly.');for(const [id,name]of current.items){const row=text(name,'',54);row.onSelect=()=>{picker=null;current.handler(id);render(true);};}table.reload();return;}
    if(state.navigation){const row=text('Room or zone',meta.name+' · tap to change');row.onSelect=()=>pick('Choose an area',state.navigation.areas.map(a=>[a.id,a.name+' · '+a.count+' lights']),id=>send('switchArea',id));}
    buttons([['Lights',()=>{view='lights';render(true);}],['Studio',()=>{view='perform';render(true);}],['Room',()=>{view='room';render(true);}],['Lab',()=>{view='lab';render(true);}]]);
    const stop=['live','preparing','adjusting','restoring','stopping'].includes(state.mode)||state.busy;
    buttons([[stop?'Pause / cancel':'Start live',()=>send(stop?'pause':'live'),stop||l.selected.length>0],
      [state.native?'Stop background':'Play in background',()=>send(state.native?'stopBridge':'background'),state.native||state.background?.available],
      ['Restore',()=>send('restore'),state.touched>0]],72);
    text(state.note||'Ready',state.error||'Light changes require a power, brightness, color, playback or restore action.',90);
    text('Bridge-reported state',TELEMETRY.summary(state.telemetry,Date.now())+'\nResource readback is not optical telemetry.',85);
    if(view==='lights'){
      const ids=l.order.slice(),dimmers=ids.filter(id=>lamp(id).capabilities.dimming),whites=ids.filter(id=>lamp(id).capabilities.temperature);
      text('Everyday lighting','On/off, brightness, white and color. Manual actions pause the local show. Values below come from Bridge reads.',90);
      if(state.session?.recoveryRequired)buttons([['Keep restore point',()=>send('resumeSession')],['Review baseline',()=>{view='lab';render(true);}]]);
      buttons([['Area on',()=>send('manual',{ids,on:true}),!state.navigation?.switching],['Area off',()=>send('manual',{ids,on:false}),!state.navigation?.switching]]);
      buttons([['Set brightness',async()=>{const raw=await input('Area brightness','1–100%. Turns dimmable lights on. Saved trim/ceiling limits still apply.','70');if(raw!==null&&raw.trim()!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(raw)))send('manual',{ids:dimmers,on:true,brightness:clamp(Number(raw),1,100)});},dimmers.length>0],['Bright 100%',()=>send('manual',{ids:dimmers,on:true,brightness:100}),dimmers.length>0]]);
      buttons([['Warm white',()=>send('manual',{ids:whites,on:true,kelvin:2700,brightness:45}),whites.length>0],['Focus white',()=>send('manual',{ids:whites,on:true,kelvin:4000,brightness:80}),whites.length>0]]);
      buttons([['Allow 100% ceilings',async()=>{if(await confirm('Raise saved ceilings?','Allow dimmable lights in this area up to 100%. Trims remain unchanged. Current brightness does not change unless the live show uses the new limit.')){for(const id of dimmers)l.placements[id].ceiling=100;changed();}},dimmers.length>0]]);
      for(const id of ids){const light=lamp(id),r=text(light.name,TELEMETRY.stateText(state.telemetry?.data?.[id]),85);r.onSelect=()=>{view='direct:'+id;render(true);};}
      buttons([['Read saved Hue scenes',()=>send('refreshScenes'),!state.savedScenes?.pending]]);
      if(state.savedScenes?.error)text('Scene read failed',state.savedScenes.error);
      if(state.savedScenes?.items?.length)buttons([['Apply static scene',()=>pick('Saved Hue scenes (static copies)',state.savedScenes.items.map(a=>[a.id,a.name]),id=>send('applyScene',id))]]);
    }else if(view.startsWith('direct:')){
      const id=view.slice(7),light=lamp(id),cap=light.capabilities,p=l.placements[id],row=state.telemetry?.data?.[id],ids=[id];
      buttons([['Back to lights',()=>{view='lights';render(true);}]]);text(light.name,TELEMETRY.stateText(row)+' · '+TELEMETRY.ageText(row?.fetchedAt,Date.now()),90);

      if(cap.dimming){const r=text('Set brightness','Tap to enter 1–100%. Enter 1–100.',String(row?.brightness||50));if(raw!==null&&raw.trim()!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(raw)))send('manual',{ids,on:true,brightness:clamp(Number(raw),1,100)});};}

      if(cap.color){const r=text('Set color','Enter a six-digit hex color, for example #00bddd.');r.onSelect=async()=>{const hex=await input('Color','Six-digit hex color. Turns this light on.','#00bddd');if(hex!==null)send('manual',{ids,on:true,hex});};}
    }else if(view==='perform'){
      buttons([['Preset library · 32',()=>pick('Curated looks',PRESET_LIBRARY.map(p=>[p.id,p.name+' · '+p.category]),id=>send('applyPreset',id))]]);
      buttons([[state.sequence?.enabled?'Stop cue sequence':'Start cue sequence',()=>send(state.sequence?.enabled?'stopSequence':'startSequence'),l.selected.length>0]]);
      text('Cue sequence',s.sequenceIds.map(id=>PRESET_LIBRARY.find(p=>p.id===id)?.name||id).join(' → ')+' · '+s.sequenceHold+' seconds each');
      buttons([['Add cue',()=>pick('Add a preset cue',PRESET_LIBRARY.map(p=>[p.id,p.name]),id=>{if(s.sequenceIds.length<12){s.sequenceIds=s.sequenceIds.concat(id);changed();}}),s.sequenceIds.length<12],['Remove last cue',()=>{s.sequenceIds=s.sequenceIds.slice(0,-1);changed();},s.sequenceIds.length>0]]);
      range('sequenceHold','Cue dwell',30,600,30,' s');field('sequenceOrder','Cue order',[['forward','Forward'],['shuffle','Seeded shuffle']]);
      if(state.hueLayouts?.areas?.some(a=>a.matched)&&!l.hue)buttons([['Use saved Hue positions',()=>{view='room';render(true);}]]);
      field('showA','Look A',ENGINE.shows);field('paletteA','Palette A',ENGINE.palettes.map((p,i)=>[i,p.name]));
      field('showB','Look B',ENGINE.shows);field('paletteB','Palette B',ENGINE.palettes.map((p,i)=>[i,p.name]));
      range('brightness','Master',5,100,5,'%');range('energy','Energy',0,100,5,'%');range('speed','Motion',.25,1.6,.05,'×');range('morph','A / B',0,100,5,'%');
      buttons([['12s lift',()=>send('surge'),state.mode==='live'],['Reverse: '+(s.reverse?'on':'off'),()=>{s.reverse=!s.reverse;changed();}]]);
      field('nativeKind','Bridge playback',[['palette','Dynamic palette'],['effect','Fixture effect']]);
      if(s.nativeKind==='effect'){
        field('effect','Advertised effect',(state.effects||[]).map(e=>[e.name,e.name+' · '+e.supported+'/'+e.total+' eligible']));
        const current=Object.values(state.effectParams||{}).filter(p=>p.effect===s.effect);
        if(current.some(p=>p.speed))range('effectSpeed','Effect speed',0,1,.05,'');
        if(current.some(p=>p.color))buttons([['Palette tint: '+(s.effectTint?'on':'off'),()=>{s.effectTint=!s.effectTint;changed();}]]);
        text('Parameter availability','Effect parameters appear only when readback advertises them. Unsupported accent/wash lamps are unchanged.');
      }
      buttons([['Apply Bridge playback',()=>send('bridge'),l.selected.length>0]]);
      buttons([['Save mix',()=>promptName('savePreset')],['Load mix',()=>pick('Saved mixes',(state.presets||[]).map(p=>[p.name,p.name]),name=>send('loadPreset',name)),!!state.presets?.length]]);
      buttons([['Export mix',()=>send('exportMix')],['Import mix',()=>send('importMix')]]);
    }else if(view==='room'){
      const info=state.hueLayouts||{};
      text('Reuse saved Hue positions',info.pending?'Reading Entertainment layouts…':info.error?'Read failed: '+info.error:info.fetchedAt==null?'Checking saved layouts.':(info.areas||[]).length+' saved Entertainment area(s). Uses your existing key; no export needed.',90);
      const pr=text('Import map projection',({xy:'Top X / Y',xz:'Front X / Z',yz:'Side Y / Z'})[hueProjectionChoice]);pr.onSelect=()=>pick('Projection',[['xy','Top X / Y'],['xz','Front X / Z'],['yz','Side Y / Z']],v=>{hueProjectionChoice=v;render(true);});
      const ph=text('Import animation path',({clockwise:'Clockwise around X / Y',x:'Left to right X',y:'Back to front Y',z:'Bottom to top Z',keep:'Keep existing phases'})[huePhaseChoice]);ph.onSelect=()=>pick('Animation path',[['clockwise','Clockwise X / Y'],['x','Left to right X'],['y','Back to front Y'],['z','Bottom to top Z'],['keep','Keep existing phases']],v=>{huePhaseChoice=v;render(true);});
      buttons([['Import Hue positions',importHueChoice,!info.pending&&!info.error&&info.areas?.some(a=>a.matched)],['Read Hue again',()=>send('refreshHueLayout'),!info.pending]]);
      buttons([['Undo layout import',async()=>{if(await confirm('Undo layout import','Return to the local layout and path topology before the last import? Live pauses; no light/Hue layout writes.'))send('undoHueLayout');},info.canUndo]]);
      if(l.hue)text('Imported from '+l.hue.areaName,'XYZ preserved. Relative coordinates, not measured metres. Local edits are retained until an explicit new import.');
      field('topology','Animation path',[['ring','Closed ring'],['path','Open path']]);
      text('Stable lamp positions','Tap a lamp to edit it. Excluding one lamp never changes another lamp’s path phase. X / Y arrange the graphical map; phase drives the show.');
      for(const id of l.order){const light=lamp(id),row=text((l.selected.includes(id)?'✓ ':'○ ')+light.name,TELEMETRY.stateText(state.telemetry?.data?.[id])+'\n'+(state.ownership?.[id]||'uncontrolled'),95);
        row.onSelect=()=>{view='lamp:'+id;render(true);};}
      buttons([['Save room',()=>promptName('saveRoom')],['Load room',()=>pick('Room layouts',(state.rooms||[]).map(p=>[p.name,p.name]),name=>send('loadRoom',name)),!!state.rooms?.length]]);
      buttons([['Redistribute clockwise',async()=>{if(await confirm('Redistribute positions','Explicitly redistribute every lamp, including unchecked lamps, along the ring?')){l.order.forEach((id,i)=>{const q=i/l.order.length;l.placements[id]={...l.placements[id],q,x:.5+.37*Math.sin(q*Math.PI*2),y:.5-.32*Math.cos(q*Math.PI*2)};});changed();}}]]);
    }else if(view.startsWith('lamp:')){
      const id=view.slice(5),light=lamp(id),p=l.placements[id];buttons([['Back to room',()=>{view='room';render(true);}]]);text(light.name,TELEMETRY.stateText(state.telemetry?.data?.[id]));text('Saved placement',huePlacementText(p));
      buttons([[l.selected.includes(id)?'Exclude lamp':'Include lamp',()=>{l.selected=l.selected.includes(id)?l.selected.filter(v=>v!==id):l.selected.concat(id);changed();}]]);
      const r=text('Role',p.role);r.onSelect=()=>pick('Light role',[['wash','Architectural wash'],['accent','Moving accent'],['task','Steady task / face'],['anchor','Steady background']],v=>{p.role=v;changed();});
      for(const [key,label,min,max,scale] of [['q','Path phase %',0,100,100],['x','Map X %',4,96,100],['y','Map Y %',6,94,100],['trim','Output trim %',10,100,100],['ceiling','Brightness cap %',5,100,1]]){
        const row=text(label,(p[key]*scale).toFixed(1)+' · tap to edit',56);row.onSelect=async()=>{const raw=await input(label,'Enter '+min+' to '+max,(p[key]*scale).toFixed(1));if(raw!==null&&raw.trim()!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(raw))){p[key]=clamp(Number(raw),min,max)/scale;changed();}};}
      if(light.capabilities.gradient>=2){buttons([['Gradients: '+(s.gradient?'on':'off'),()=>{s.gradient=!s.gradient;changed();}],['Reverse strip',()=>{p.stripReverse=!p.stripReverse;changed();}]]);
        for(const [key,label,min,max,scale]of[['extent','Strip extent %',2,50,100],['angle','Strip map angle',-180,180,1]]){const row=text(label,String(p[key]*scale),56);row.onSelect=async()=>{const raw=await input(label,'Enter '+min+' to '+max,p[key]*scale);if(raw!==null&&raw.trim()!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(raw))){p[key]=clamp(Number(raw),min,max)/scale;changed();}};}}
      const idx=l.order.indexOf(id);buttons([['Move earlier',()=>{[l.order[idx],l.order[idx-1]]=[l.order[idx-1],l.order[idx]];changed();},idx>0],['Move later',()=>{[l.order[idx],l.order[idx+1]]=[l.order[idx+1],l.order[idx]];changed();},idx<l.order.length-1]]);
    }else{
      text('Request budget',(state.stats?.latencyMs||0)+' ms smoothed request time · '+((state.stats?.horizonMs||0)/1000).toFixed(1)+' s horizon\n'+(state.stats?.writes||0)+' accepted writes · '+(state.stats?.failures||0)+' failures');
      for(const args of [['depth','Depth',0,100,5,'%'],['spread','Width',.5,2,.05,'×'],['tension','Color tension',0,100,5,'%'],['focus','Focus',0,100,5,'%'],['saturation','Saturation',0,100,5,'%'],['ambientFloor','Atmosphere floor',0,65,5,'%'],['accentMix','Accent amount',0,100,5,'%'],['density','Ring copies',1,4,1,''],['phaseOffset','Phase offset',-1,1,.05,''],['brightnessCurve','Intensity curve',.5,2,.05,'×'],['directorSeconds','Director act',30,180,5,' s']])range(...args);
      text('Appearance','Native controls follow system appearance. The graphical panel adds System / Light / Dark overrides in Lab.');
      for(let ci=0;ci<4;ci++){const row=text('Custom palette color '+(ci+1),s.customColors[ci]+' · tap to edit');row.onSelect=async()=>{const raw=await input('Hex color','Enter #RRGGBB',s.customColors[ci]);if(raw!==null&&/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw)){s.customColors=s.customColors.slice();s.customColors[ci]=raw;changed();}};}
      field('ownership','External control',[['yield_off','Yield to external off'],['hold','Keep enforcing on']]);
      const seedRow=text('Seed',String(s.seed)+' · tap to edit');seedRow.onSelect=async()=>{const value=await input('Seed','Integer 0–999999',s.seed);if(value!==null&&Number.isFinite(Number(value))){s.seed=Math.round(clamp(Number(value),0,999999));changed();}};
      const fadeRow=text('Edit crossfade',s.transitionMs/1000+' seconds');fadeRow.onSelect=async()=>{const value=await input('Crossfade','Seconds: 2.5–15',s.transitionMs/1000);if(value!==null&&Number.isFinite(Number(value))){s.transitionMs=clamp(Number(value),2.5,15)*1000;changed();}};
      text('Restore point',state.session?.createdAt?new Date(state.session.createdAt).toLocaleString():'Legacy / capture date unknown');
      text(state.session?.recoveryRequired?'Recovery choice required':'Static restore only','Prior animations are not resumed. Archived sessions remain available.');
      buttons([['Resume saved point',()=>send('resumeSession'),state.session?.recoveryRequired],['New baseline',async()=>{if(await confirm('New session','Archive the current baseline? Fresh values are captured on the next Start.'))send('newSession');},!state.busy&&!state.native]],76);
      buttons([['Archived baselines',()=>pick('Archived sessions',(state.session?.archives||[]).map(a=>[a.id,a.createdAt?new Date(a.createdAt).toLocaleString():'Unknown capture date']),id=>send('restoreArchive',id)),!!state.session?.archives?.length&&!state.busy&&!state.native]]);
      buttons([['Redacted diagnostics',()=>send('exportDiagnostics')]]);
      for(const id of l.order){const t=state.telemetry||{},r=t.data?.[id];text(lamp(id).name,TELEMETRY.stateText(r)+'\n'+TELEMETRY.ageText(r?.fetchedAt,Date.now())+' · '+TELEMETRY.connection(t.links?.[r?.owner],Date.now())+'\n'+TELEMETRY.targetText(t.targets?.[id],Date.now())+'\n'+(state.ownership?.[id]||'uncontrolled'),120);}
    }
    text('Foreground live / phone-free Bridge playback','Done stops new live work and leaves current states. Stop Bridge or Restore changes delegated playback. Trusted Wi-Fi only; local certificate validation is disabled.',110);
    table.reload();
  }
  function report(next){if(next.meta&&next.meta.scopeId!==meta.scopeId){meta=next.meta;dirty=false;command=null;picker=null;view='lights';s=clone(next.settings);l=clone(next.layout);}state=next;let force=false;if(!dirty){if(JSON.stringify(s)!==JSON.stringify(next.settings)){s=clone(next.settings);force=true;}if(JSON.stringify(l)!==JSON.stringify(next.layout)){l=clone(next.layout);force=true;}}render(force);}
  render(true);
  return {present:()=>table.present(false),async exchange(next){report(next);const packet={edit:dirty?{settings:clone(s),layout:clone(l)}:null,command,hidden:false};dirty=false;command=null;return packet;},async report(next){report(next);},async fail(message){state={...state,error:message,note:'Close with Done and reopen.',mode:'error'};render(true);}};
}


// ===== runtime =====
// Preserve the working 2.1 WebView startup strategy and native fallback.
async function uiTimeout(promise,label,ms=7000){let timer;try{return await Promise.race([promise,new Promise((_,reject)=>{timer=Timer.schedule(ms,false,()=>reject(new Error(label+' timed out. Use Compatibility controls.')));})]);}finally{if(timer)timer.invalidate();}}
function localDeckRequest(request){const url=String(request?.url||'');return url===''||/^about:blank(?:[?#]|$)/i.test(url)||/^data:text\/html[;,]/i.test(url);}
async function makeWebPanel(meta,initial){
  const view=new WebView();view.shouldAllowRequest=localDeckRequest;
  await uiTimeout(view.loadHTML(buildPage(meta,initial)),'Loading interface');
  const raw=await uiTimeout(view.evaluateJavaScript('JSON.stringify({ready:!!(window.DECK_BOOT&&window.DECK_BOOT.ready&&window.DECK),error:window.DECK_BOOT&&window.DECK_BOOT.error||""})',false),'Checking interface');
  const boot=JSON.parse(raw);if(!boot.ready||boot.error)throw new Error('Interface initialization failed: '+(boot.error||'control bridge missing'));
  return {present:()=>view.present(false),async exchange(next){const text=await uiTimeout(view.evaluateJavaScript('(function(){if(window.DECK_BOOT.error)return JSON.stringify({uiError:window.DECK_BOOT.error});return window.DECK.exchange('+safeJSON(next)+');})()',false),'Reading interface');const p=JSON.parse(text);if(p.uiError)throw new Error(p.uiError);return p;},
    async report(next){await uiTimeout(view.evaluateJavaScript('window.DECK.report('+safeJSON(next)+');true;',false),'Updating interface');},
    async fail(message){try{await uiTimeout(view.evaluateJavaScript('window.deckBootError('+safeJSON(message)+');true;',false),'Showing error',1500);}catch(_){}}};
}
function validatePreset(value){if(!value||!['hue-board',LEGACY_MIX_APP].includes(value.app)||value.schema!==3||!value.settings||typeof value.settings!=='object')throw new Error('Expected a Hue Board schema 3 mix. Nothing was imported.');return ENGINE.clean(value.settings);}
async function exportDocument(name,value){const fm=FileManager.local(),path=fm.joinPath(fm.documentsDirectory(),name);fm.writeString(path,JSON.stringify(value,null,2));await ShareSheet.present([path]);}
async function runDeck(cfg,group,kind='web',groups=[group]){
  const ctl=makeWorkspaceController(cfg,groups,group);let panel,closed=false,uiError='';
  try{panel=kind==='compatibility'?makeCompatibilityPanel(ctl.meta,ctl.state()):await makeWebPanel(ctl.meta,ctl.state());}
  catch(e){await ctl.close();throw e;}
  const presentation=panel.present().then(()=>{closed=true;},e=>{closed=true;uiError=shortError(e);});
  await sleep(350);
  let auxiliary=null;
  try{while(!closed){const packet=await panel.exchange(ctl.state());if(closed)break;
      if(packet.edit)ctl.update(packet.edit);
      const command=packet.command;
      if(command&&['exportDiagnostics','exportMix','importMix'].includes(command.name)){
        // Pause before presenting a native share sheet or clipboard prompt. Never overlap auxiliary dialogs.
        ctl.dispatch('pause','Opening export/import');
        if(!auxiliary){const before=ctl.state();auxiliary=(async()=>{
          if(command.name==='exportDiagnostics')await exportDocument('hue-board-diagnostics.json',ctl.diagnostics());
          else if(command.name==='exportMix')await exportDocument('hue-board-mix.json',{app:'hue-board',schema:3,settings:before.settings});
          else {const value=await input('Import mix','Paste a Hue Board schema 3 JSON mix. Importing does not start lights.','');if(value!==null){const s=validatePreset(JSON.parse(value));ctl.update({settings:s,layout:ctl.state().layout});}}
        })().catch(e=>inform('Export / import',shortError(e))).finally(()=>{auxiliary=null;});}
      }else if(command)ctl.dispatch(command.name,command.payload);
      ctl.tick(packet.hidden||!!auxiliary);
      await sleep(120);
    }
  }catch(e){uiError=shortError(e);ctl.dispatch('pause');if(!closed)await panel.fail(uiError);}
  finally{await ctl.close();}
  await presentation;if(auxiliary)await auxiliary;if(uiError)console.warn(uiError);
}
async function shortcutBackground(cfg,group,groups,command,presetId=null){
  const ctl=makeWorkspaceController(cfg,groups,group,{autoDiscover:false});
  try{
    if(presetId&&!PRESET_LIBRARY.some(p=>p.id===presetId))throw new HueError('validation','Unknown scene preset. No lights changed.');
    ctl.dispatch(command,presetId);ctl.tick(false);await ctl.settled();
    const result=ctl.state();
    if(result.error)throw new HueError('control',result.error);
    if(command==='stopBridge'&&result.native)throw new HueError('control','Some delegated playback remains. Open the control deck to inspect.');
    if(command!=='stopBridge'&&!result.native)throw new HueError('control',result.note||'Bridge playback could not be started.');
    if(typeof Script.setShortcutOutput==='function')Script.setShortcutOutput(command==='stopBridge'?'Bridge stop requested':'Bridge playback accepted');
  }finally{await ctl.close();}
}
async function main(){const cfg=readConfig();if(!await bridgeSetup(cfg)||!await ensurePairing(cfg))return;
  let groups=await inventory(cfg);if(!groups.length)throw new Error('No controllable Hue lights found.');
  if(!getGroup(cfg,groups)&&!await selectGroup(cfg,groups))return;
  const shortcut=typeof args!=='undefined'&&typeof args.shortcutParameter==='string'?args.shortcutParameter.trim():'';
  const action=shortcut==='background'?'background':shortcut==='stop-background'?'stopBridge':shortcut.startsWith('background:')?'backgroundPreset':null;
  if(action){await shortcutBackground(cfg,getGroup(cfg,groups),groups,action,action==='backgroundPreset'?shortcut.slice('background:'.length):null);return;}
  for(;;){const g=getGroup(cfg,groups);if(!g){if(!await selectGroup(cfg,groups))return;continue;}
    const action=await choose('Hue Board',g.name+'\nYour existing pairing is reused. Do not run another Hue Board controller at the same time.',
      ['Open control deck','Compatibility controls (no WebView)','Play in background','Stop background','Choose room / zone','Change Bridge address','Refresh inventory'],'Exit');if(action<0)return;
    if(action===2||action===3){try{await shortcutBackground(cfg,g,groups,action===2?'background':'stopBridge');await inform('Hue Board',action===2?'Bridge playback accepted. Lock your phone if you wish.':'Bridge stop accepted.');}catch(e){await inform('Playback',shortError(e));}continue;}
    if(action<=1){try{await runDeck(cfg,g,action===1?'compatibility':'web',groups);}catch(e){await inform('Control deck',shortError(e)+'\nThe native compatibility controls remain available.');}}
    else if(action===4)await selectGroup(cfg,groups);
    else if(action===5){if(await bridgeSetup(cfg,true)&&await ensurePairing(cfg)){groups=await inventory(cfg);if(!getGroup(cfg,groups)&&!await selectGroup(cfg,groups))return;}}
    else groups=await inventory(cfg);
  }
}

try { await main(); } catch(e) { console.error(shortError(e)); await inform("Hue Board / ERROR",shortError(e)); } finally { Script.complete(); }
